===== src/buster/lib/compiler/frontend/c/c_parse.c =====

     1: // Parsing and semantic analysis, the second stage of the frontend. Two
     2: // passes over the preprocessed token stream, entered through c_parse_ast and
     3: // c_analyze_semantics at the bottom of the file (c_parse runs both):
     4: // - c_parse_ast is one linear scan that splits the stream into top-level
     5: //   CParserDeclaration records â token extents, the name token, the body
     6: //   range, and typedef/constexpr/variadic flags â by delimiter counting
     7: //   alone. It builds no tree; every later consumer re-walks token ranges.
     8: //   The same top-level/body walks validate active integer token spellings,
     9: //   including unevaluated operands, before any type-only shortcut can hide one.
    10: //   A function body is split into statements the same way, and the one fact
    11: //   kept about them is the token range of each _Static_assert statement
    12: //   (CParserStaticAssert), which c_parse_bind_function_static_asserts
    13: //   checks against the block scopes the body binder creates. Body splitting
    14: //   reuses one depth-sized CParserBodyFrames vector; published declarations
    15: //   and assertion ranges remain owned by the translation-unit arena.
    16: //   One record is one declarator, not one declaration: a comma-separated
    17: //   list is split into a record per declarator, each keeping the shared
    18: //   specifiers in token_start/token_count and its own declarator segment in
    19: //   declarator_start/declarator_count.
    20: // - c_analyze_semantics sizes its tables from a token census
    21: //   (c_parse_token_census, vectorized), then builds the CParseResult the
    22: //   lowering stage consumes: interned types, entities, scopes, and
    23: //   diagnostics.
    24: //
    25: // Types and declarators are parsed by CTypeParseMachine (types in
    26: // c_internal.h), an explicit frame stack in place of recursion: each
    27: // CTypeParseFrameKind has a c_type_parse_*_step function dispatched by
    28: // c_type_parse_machine_run. Speculative parses record every published-type
    29: // mutation (c_type_parse_record_mutation) so c_type_parse_rollback can
    30: // restore the shared type table after a failed attempt.
    31: //
    32: // Layout, in file order; each anchor is a definition to search for:
    33: //   c_parse_token_class_compute,                  keyword and token
    34: //   c_parse_position_index_build                  classification, the
    35: //                                                 matching-delimiter index
    36: //   c_parse_builtin_type_layout,                  target-dependent type
    37: //   c_parse_type_layout                           sizes/alignments, aggregate
    38: //                                                 and bit-field layout
    39: //   c_semantic_check_named_call_arities          bound call constraints without IR
    40: //   c_parse_bfloat16_builtin,                    target builtin signatures
    41: //   c_parse_validate_bfloat16_builtin_calls       checked before unused pruning
    42: //   c_parse_direct_expression_base ..             expression typing without
    43: //   c_parse_conditional_expression_type           lowering (usual arithmetic
    44: //                                                 conversions, precedence,
    45: //                                                 and the null-pointer-
    46: //                                                 constant rule a conditional
    47: //                                                 picks a pointer type with)
    48: //   c_parse_static_assert_evaluate                _Static_assert, including
    49: //                                                 deferral past unresolved
    50: //                                                 array bounds
    51: //   c_parse_initializer_designator,               initializer shapes and
    52: //   c_parse_infer_initializer_array_count_core    array-bound inference
    53: //   c_parse_add_type, c_parse_aggregate_lookup,   type interning and
    54: //   c_parse_primitive_type                        construction, attributes
    55: //   c_parse_word_bits_compute,                    specifier words answered
    56: //   c_parse_word_bits_token                       from the interned symbol
    57: //                                                 id (C_WORD_* bits), with
    58: //                                                 the spelling ladders as
    59: //                                                 the symbol-0 fallback
    60: //   c_type_parse_alignment_step ..                the type-parse machine
    61: //   c_type_parse_machine_run                      steps
    62: //   c_parse_scalar_type_core_begin,               declarators: pointers,
    63: //   c_parse_pointer_chain, c_parse_array_suffixes arrays, parameters
    64: //   c_parse_validate_constexpr_declaration,       constexpr, type
    65: //   c_parse_types_compatible                      compatibility
    66: //   c_parse_validate_cleanup_attribute            __attribute__((cleanup))
    67: //   c_parse_name_symbol .. c_parse_lookup_*       symbol interning, scopes,
    68: //                                                 entity lookup
    69: //   c_parse_local_declarations                    block-scope declarations,
    70: //                                                 auto inference, local
    71: //                                                 functions
    72: //   c_parse_label_address_prefix_proven,          statement boundaries, asm
    73: //   c_parse_statement_end                         goto, label addresses
    74: //   c_parse_bind_function_body                    binds body identifiers to
    75: //                                                 entities, indexes scopes
    76: //   c_parse_token_census_reference,               the token-shape census that
    77: //   c_parse_token_census                          sizes c_analyze_semantics'
    78: //                                                 tables: contiguous sidecar
    79: //                                                 shape compares plus a
    80: //                                                 symbol-byte projection for
    81: //                                                 the rare `for` spelling,
    82: //                                                 with the scalar reference
    83: //                                                 kept as the differential gate
    84: //   c_parse_ast, c_analyze_semantics, c_parse     the stage entry points
    85: 
    86: #include "c_internal.h"
    87: #include <buster/lib/compiler/frontend/c/c_parse_internal.h>

    89: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_declaration_keyword(String8 spelling)
    90: {
    91:     if (!c_declaration_keyword_slots_built)
    92:     {
    93:         c_declaration_keyword_slots_build();
    94:     }
    95:     u32 slot = (u32)(c_macro_name_hash(spelling) & (C_DECLARATION_KEYWORD_SLOT_COUNT - 1));
    96:     while (c_declaration_keyword_slots[slot])
    97:     {
    98:         if (string_equal(spelling, c_declaration_keyword_spellings[c_declaration_keyword_slots[slot] - 1]))
    99:         {
   100:             return true;
   101:         }
   102:         slot = (slot + 1) & (C_DECLARATION_KEYWORD_SLOT_COUNT - 1);
   103:     }
   104:     return false;
   105: }
   106: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_declaration_keyword_for_dialect(String8 spelling, CPreprocessDialect dialect)
   107: {
   108:     return c_declaration_keyword(spelling) ||
   109:            (c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(dialect) &&
   110:              (string_equal(spelling, S8("true")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("false")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("nullptr")) ||
   111:               string_equal(spelling, S8("alignof")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("constexpr")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("typeof_unqual")))) ||
   112:            ((c_preprocess_dialect_is_gnu(dialect) || c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(dialect)) && string_equal(spelling, S8("typeof")));
   113: }
   114: 
   115: // Spelling predicates the parser's scan loops ask per token, per scan, cached
   116: // as one class byte per token index. Token spellings are fixed once
   117: // preprocessing finishes, so the byte is computed at most once per token no
   118: // matter how many declaration scans revisit it, and speculative-parse
   119: // rollbacks cannot invalidate it.
   120: enum
   121: {
   122:     C_TOKEN_CLASS_COMPUTED = 1 << 0,
   123:     C_TOKEN_CLASS_DECLARATION_KEYWORD = 1 << 1,
   124:     C_TOKEN_CLASS_C23_EXTRA_KEYWORD = 1 << 2,
   125:     C_TOKEN_CLASS_TYPEOF = 1 << 3,
   126:     C_TOKEN_CLASS_VECTOR_SIZE = 1 << 4,
   127:     C_TOKEN_CLASS_ALIGNAS = 1 << 5,
   128: };
   129: 
   130: // Specifier-word facts stored per predefined symbol id in
   131: // CSymbolTable.word_bits, derived at table-create time from the same
   132: // spelling predicates the `_token` variants below fall back to, so the two
   133: // paths cannot drift. The qualifier bits carry which qualifier matched
   134: // because c_parse_type_qualifier_word reports its answer by setting the
   135: // matching CType flag.
   136: enum
   137: {
   138:     C_WORD_TYPE = 1 << 0,
   139:     C_WORD_AUTO_TYPE = 1 << 1,
   140:     C_WORD_TYPEOF = 1 << 2,
   141:     C_WORD_CONSTEXPR = 1 << 3,
   142:     C_WORD_TYPEOF_UNQUAL = 1 << 4,
   143:     C_WORD_QUALIFIER_CONST = 1 << 5,
   144:     C_WORD_QUALIFIER_VOLATILE = 1 << 6,
   145:     C_WORD_QUALIFIER_RESTRICT = 1 << 7,
   146:     C_WORD_QUALIFIER_ATOMIC = 1 << 8,
   147:     C_WORD_STORAGE_PREFIX = 1 << 9,
   148:     // A decoration c_parse_skip_attributes steps over ahead of a type's
   149:     // first word -- `__attribute__`, `__attribute`, `__declspec` and the asm
   150:     // label keywords -- so that "may this word start a type name" is the one
   151:     // mask test C_WORD_TYPE_NAME_START_ANY spells.
   152:     C_WORD_TYPE_NAME_DECORATION = 1 << 10,
   153: };
   154: 
   155: #define C_WORD_QUALIFIER_ANY (C_WORD_QUALIFIER_CONST | C_WORD_QUALIFIER_VOLATILE | C_WORD_QUALIFIER_RESTRICT | C_WORD_QUALIFIER_ATOMIC)
   156: 
   157: // Every word that can stand first in a type name: a type or qualifier
   158: // keyword (the tags, `_Atomic`, `__typeof__` and `_Alignas` are type words),
   159: // the dialect-gated typeof/typeof_unqual/__auto_type/constexpr spellings --
   160: // taken in every dialect, since a wrong "maybe" only costs the probe the test
   161: // exists to skip -- and the decorations.  What c_ir_type_name_prefix and
   162: // c_ir_primitive_type_kind accept begins with one of these or with an
   163: // identifier naming a typedef.
   164: #define C_WORD_TYPE_NAME_START_ANY                                                                                                       \
   165:     (C_WORD_TYPE | C_WORD_AUTO_TYPE | C_WORD_TYPEOF | C_WORD_CONSTEXPR | C_WORD_TYPEOF_UNQUAL | C_WORD_QUALIFIER_ANY | C_WORD_TYPE_NAME_DECORATION)
   166: 
   167: // The `_token` specifier predicates: same answers as their String8
   168: // counterparts, but an interned token settles on one word_bits load instead
   169: // of a spelling ladder. Symbol 0 (pasted, synthesized, or test-built tokens)
   170: // falls back to the spelling compute, so a missed path costs speed and never
   171: // correctness; a symbol above predefined_limit is a constant-time "no"
   172: // because every specifier-word spelling is interned into the predefined
   173: // range. Defined after the spelling ladders they derive from.

  1202:     // A complex value is two contiguous elements of its real type, so it is
  1203:     // twice as wide and no more strictly aligned. Clang agrees on all three
  1204:     // for every target here: sizeof/_Alignof are {8,4}, {16,8} and
  1205:     // {2*sizeof(long double), _Alignof(long double)}.
  1206:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT16_COMPLEX:

  1209:         break;

  1232:         alignment = layout.va_list.alignment;
  1233:         break;
  1234:     // GNU gives `void` a size and an alignment of one so that arithmetic on a
  1235:     // `void *` steps by bytes; clang and gcc both fold `sizeof(void)`,
  1236:     // `sizeof(const void)` and `_Alignof(void)` to 1. It is an extension for
  1237:     // that arithmetic and for `sizeof`, never a licence to declare a `void`
  1238:     // object: every refusal of one keys on the *kind*, not on a zero size.
  1239:     case C_TYPE_VOID:
  1240:         size = 1;
  1241:         alignment = 1;
  1242:         break;
  1243:     case C_TYPE_ARRAY:
  1244:     case C_TYPE_VECTOR:
  1245:     case C_TYPE_STRUCT:
  1246:     case C_TYPE_UNION:
  1247:     case C_TYPE_ENUM:
  1248:     case C_TYPE_INVALID:
  1249:     case C_TYPE_COUNT:
  1250:         return false;
  1251:     }
  1252:     *size_out = size;
  1253:     *alignment_out = alignment;
  1254:     return true;
  1255: }
  1256: 
  1257: /* The layout `_Atomic T` has, given T's own.  Clang treats `_Atomic T` as
  1258:    *constructing* a type rather than qualifying one: a value it could operate on
  1259:    lock-free is padded up to the next power of two and aligned there, which is
  1260:    what makes `_Atomic struct { char a, b, c; }` four bytes aligned four where
  1261:    the record itself is three bytes aligned one, and what gives every atomic
  1262:    scalar an alignment equal to its size -- `_Atomic _Complex double` is
  1263:    sixteen-byte aligned where the complex type is eight.  The ceiling is the
  1264:    target's maximum lock-free width, `TargetDataLayout::atomic_max_width`: 128
  1265:    bits everywhere here but wasm64 and BPF, where it is 64.  A type wider than
  1266:    that keeps T's layout untouched, so the rule is not "round every aggregate
  1267:    up" -- Clang leaves a seventeen-byte record seventeen bytes aligned one --
  1268:    and a zero-sized aggregate still takes one byte, because an atomic operation
  1269:    on it has to touch something.  GCC pads nothing and raises the alignment only
  1270:    where the size is already a power of two; AGENTS.md names Clang the oracle
  1271:    and the divergence is an ABI one (#731).
  1272: 
  1273:    Both layout engines ask here, or a folded `sizeof` contradicts the object it
  1274:    measures the way `packed` and `aligned` already have the rule for:
  1275:    c_parse_type_layout below applies it to every atomic type it resolves, and
  1276:    c_ir_add_qualified_type in c_gen.c applies it to the copy the mapping pass
  1277:    builds.  Both read the width from the *preprocess* target's data layout --
  1278:    `program->data_layout` is that same record -- so the two cannot answer with
  1279:    different ceilings.  An **array keeps its own layout**: `_Atomic` of one is a
  1280:    constraint violation Clang and GCC both refuse, this frontend does not
  1281:    diagnose it in every position, and `c_ir_add_qualified_type` refuses to build
  1282:    the type at all -- so promoting here would leave the two engines answering
  1283:    16 and 12 for a type neither should have built.  Both callers below that can
  1284:    see one say so; the seed cannot, because no array resolves there. */
  1285: BUSTER_C_SHARED void c_atomic_promoted_layout(u32 atomic_max_width, u64* size, u32* alignment)
  1286: {
  1287:     u64 promoted = *size ? *size : 1;
  1288:     if (promoted <= atomic_max_width / 8)
  1289:     {
  1290:         u64 rounded = 1;
  1291:         while (rounded < promoted)
  1292:         {
  1293:             rounded *= 2;
  1294:         }
  1295:         *size = rounded;
  1296:         *alignment = (u32)rounded;
  1297:     }
  1298: }

  1306: typedef struct CParseLayoutContext CParseLayoutContext;
  1307: struct CParseLayoutContext
  1308: {
  1309:     CTypeParseMachine* machine;
  1310:     Arena* arena;
  1311:     CPreprocessResult preprocess;
  1312:     CParseResult* result;

  1318: 
  1319: // Raises `*alignment` to each alignment specifier of [start, start + count),
  1320: // which is what c_ir_alignment_evaluate does for the IR layout; the two run
  1321: // over the same records and must agree on the number. Answers false only when
  1322: // a specifier names a type whose own layout is still unresolved, which sends
  1323: // the aggregate back to a later pass.
  1324: //
  1325: // A request the alignment already satisfies is ignored rather than refused:
  1326: // GNU `aligned(N)` only ever raises, so `aligned(2)` on an already 4-aligned
  1327: // member is the no-op GCC and Clang make of it. A request this engine cannot
  1328: // use at all -- not a power of two, or wider than a u32 -- is ignored here
  1329: // too, as is a below-natural `_Alignas`, which C does forbid: the IR side
  1330: // evaluates the same records, reports those by name, and lays the type out
  1331: // with this same maximum, and refusing the fold here only replaced that
  1332: // diagnostic with whatever a caller says when a sizeof will not fold.
  1333: // `requested_out`, when asked for, receives the largest alignment any of the
  1334: // records *asks* for, before it is merged with the declared type's natural
  1335: // alignment. Only the bit-field placement rule needs that raw number: GNU
  1336: // `aligned(N)` starts a bit-field at the next multiple of N bytes even when N
  1337: // is below the declared type's own alignment, while every other reader of a
  1338: // request only ever raises with it. Zero means no record resolved.
  1339: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_layout_alignment_specifiers(CParseLayoutContext* context, u32 start, u32 count, u32* alignment, u32* requested_out,
  1340:                                                            bool* provisional_out)
  1341: {
  1342:     bool valid = true;
  1343:     for (u32 specifier_index = 0; specifier_index < count; specifier_index += 1)
  1344:     {
  1345:         if (start > context->result->alignment_count || specifier_index >= context->result->alignment_count - start)
  1346:         {
  1347:             valid = false;
  1348:             break;
  1349:         }
  1350:         CAlignmentSpecifier specifier = context->result->alignments[start + specifier_index];
  1351:         u64 requested_alignment = 0;
  1352:         if (specifier.type.value < context->type_count)
  1353:         {
  1354:             if (!context->resolved[specifier.type.value])
  1355:             {
  1356:                 valid = false;

  2423: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CBfloat16Builtin const* c_parse_bfloat16_builtin(String8 name)
  2424: {
  2425:     CBfloat16Builtin const* result = 0;
  2426:     if (string_starts_with_sequence(name, S8("__builtin_ia32_")))
  2427:     {
  2428:         for (u32 index = 0; index < BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(c_bfloat16_builtins) && !result; index += 1)
  2429:         {
  2430:             if (string_equal(name, c_bfloat16_builtins[index].name)) result = c_bfloat16_builtins + index;
  2431:         }
  2432:     }
  2433:     return result;
  2434: }

  2436: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_bfloat16_builtin_result(CParseResult* result, CBfloat16Builtin const* builtin)
  2437: {
  2438:     CBfloat16BuiltinType shape = builtin->types[0];
  2439:     CTypeId type = c_parse_add_type(result, (CType){
  2440:         .element_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
  2441:         .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
  2442:         .unqualified_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
  2443:         .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
  2444:         .kind = shape.kind,
  2445:         .is_complete = true,
  2446:     });
  2447:     if (shape.lanes && type.value < result->type_count)
  2448:     {
  2449:         type = c_parse_add_type(result, (CType){
  2450:             .element_type = type,
  2451:             .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
  2452:             .unqualified_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
  2453:             .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
  2454:             .kind = C_TYPE_VECTOR,
  2455:             .vector_byte_size = (u32)shape.lanes * (shape.kind == C_TYPE_FLOAT ? 4u : 2u),
  2456:             .is_complete = true,
  2457:         });
  2458:     }
  2459:     return type;
  2460: }
  2461: 
  2462: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL CTypeId c_parse_direct_expression_base(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope,
  2463:                                                          u32 base_start, u32 base_end)
  2464: {
  2465:     CTypeId type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2466:     bool call_base = base_end > base_start + 2 && preprocess.tokens[base_start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
  2467:                      c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[base_start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
  2468:                      c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[base_end - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
  2469:     if ((base_end == base_start + 1 || call_base) && preprocess.tokens[base_start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
  2470:     {
  2471:         CEntityId entity_id = C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
  2472:         u32 base_use_index = c_parse_identifier_use_index(result, base_start);
  2473:         if (base_use_index != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  2474:         {
  2475:             entity_id = result->identifier_uses[base_use_index].entity;
  2476:         }
  2477:         CScopeId lookup_scope = scope;
  2478:         if (lookup_scope.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && result->scope_count)
  2479:         {
  2480:             lookup_scope = (CScopeId){
  2481:                 .value = 0,
  2482:             };
  2483:         }
  2484:         if (entity_id.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && lookup_scope.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  2485:         {
  2486:             entity_id = c_parse_lookup_entity_token(result, preprocess.spelling_base, lookup_scope, &preprocess.tokens[base_start]);
  2487:         }
  2488:         type = entity_id.value < result->entity_count && result->entities[entity_id.value].kind != C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF &&
  2489:                        result->entities[entity_id.value].kind != C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR
  2490:                    ? result->entities[entity_id.value].type
  2491:                    : C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2492:         // A call base -- `_PyBaseExceptionObject_cast(self)->context` is what
  2493:         // CPython's Py_XSETREF callers hand _Py_TYPEOF -- contributes its
  2494:         // return type, through a function pointer's pointee when the name
  2495:         // binds to one.
  2496:         if (call_base && type.value < result->type_count)
  2497:         {
  2498:             CType* base_type = &result->types[type.value];
  2499:             if (base_type->kind == C_TYPE_POINTER && base_type->element_type.value < result->type_count)
  2500:             {
  2501:                 base_type = &result->types[base_type->element_type.value];
  2502:             }
  2503:             type = base_type->kind == C_TYPE_FUNCTION ? base_type->return_type : C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2504:         }
  2505:         else if (call_base && entity_id.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  2506:         {
  2507:             CBfloat16Builtin const* builtin = c_parse_bfloat16_builtin(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[base_start]));
  2508:             if (builtin)
  2509:             {
  2510:                 c_parse_position_index_append(result->arena, &result->bfloat16_builtin_calls, &result->bfloat16_builtin_call_count,
  2511:                                                &result->bfloat16_builtin_call_capacity, base_start);
  2512:                 type = c_parse_bfloat16_builtin_result(result, builtin);
  2513:             }
  2514:         }
  2515:     }
  2516:     else if (base_start < base_end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[base_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
  2517:     {
  2518:         // A cast base: `((propertyobject *) new)->prop_name` is what
  2519:         // Py_SETREF writes through _Py_TYPEOF, so `__typeof__` over it must
  2520:         // resolve or the declaration it types declares nothing.  The cast's
  2521:         // own type is the whole answer -- the operand after it only carries
  2522:         // the value -- and the machineless resolvers exist exactly for walks
  2523:         // like this one that may run inside a machine step.
  2524:         u32 cast_close = c_parse_matching_delimiter_indexed(result, preprocess, base_start);
  2525:         if (cast_close < base_end && cast_close + 1 < base_end)
  2526:         {
  2527:             u32 type_index = base_start + 1;
  2528:             CTypeId cast_type = c_parse_machineless_base_type(result, preprocess, scope, base_start + 1, cast_close, &type_index);
  2529:             if (cast_type.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  2530:             {
  2531:                 cast_type = c_parse_pointer_chain(result, preprocess, cast_type, &type_index, cast_close);
  2532:                 if (type_index == cast_close)
  2533:                 {
  2534:                     type = cast_type;
  2535:                 }
  2536:             }
  2537:         }
  2538:     }
  2539:     return type;
  2540: }

  2542: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL CTypeId c_parse_direct_expression_postfix(Arena* arena, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result,
  2543:                                                             CTypeId type, u32 start, u32 end)
  2544: {
  2545:     u32 index = start;
  2546:     while (index < end && type.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  2547:     {
  2548:         if (type.value >= result->type_count)
  2549:         {
  2550:             type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2551:             break;
  2552:         }
  2553:         CType* type_value = &result->types[type.value];
  2554:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
  2555:         {
  2556:             u32 close = c_parse_matching_delimiter_indexed(result, preprocess, index);
  2557:             if (close >= end || (type_value->kind != C_TYPE_ARRAY && type_value->kind != C_TYPE_POINTER))
  2558:             {
  2559:                 type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2560:                 break;
  2561:             }
  2562:             type = type_value->element_type;
  2563:             index = close + 1;
  2564:             continue;
  2565:         }
  2566:         bool indirect = c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW);
  2567:         if (!indirect && !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT))
  2568:         {
  2569:             type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2570:             break;
  2571:         }
  2572:         if (indirect)
  2573:         {
  2574:             if (type_value->kind != C_TYPE_POINTER || type_value->element_type.value >= result->type_count)
  2575:             {
  2576:                 type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2577:                 break;
  2578:             }
  2579:             type = type_value->element_type;
  2580:             type_value = &result->types[type.value];
  2581:         }
  2582:         if (index + 1 >= end || preprocess.tokens[index + 1].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER ||
  2583:             (type_value->kind != C_TYPE_STRUCT && type_value->kind != C_TYPE_UNION))
  2584:         {
  2585:             type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2586:             break;
  2587:         }
  2588:         CTypeId field_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2589:         TemporalArena field_search = arena_begin_temporal(arena);
  2590:         CTypeId* work = arena_allocate(field_search.arena, CTypeId, result->type_count + 1);
  2591:         bool* visited = arena_allocate(field_search.arena, bool, result->type_count + 1);
  2592:         memset(visited, 0, sizeof(*visited) * (result->type_count + 1));
  2593:         u32 work_index = 0;
  2594:         u32 work_count = 1;
  2595:         work[0] = type;
  2596:         visited[type.value] = true;
  2597:         while (work_index < work_count && field_type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  2598:         {
  2599:             CTypeId candidate_id = work[work_index++];
  2600:             CType* candidate = &result->types[candidate_id.value];
  2601:             for (u32 field_index = 0; field_index < candidate->member_count; field_index += 1)
  2602:             {
  2603:                 CMember* member = &result->members[candidate->member_start + field_index];
  2604:                 if (string_equal(member->name, c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index + 1])))
  2605:                 {
  2606:                     field_type = member->type;
  2607:                     break;
  2608:                 }
  2609:                 if (member->name.length || member->type.value >= result->type_count || visited[member->type.value])
  2610:                 {
  2611:                     continue;
  2612:                 }
  2613:                 CType* nested = &result->types[member->type.value];
  2614:                 if (nested->kind != C_TYPE_STRUCT && nested->kind != C_TYPE_UNION)
  2615:                 {
  2616:                     continue;
  2617:                 }
  2618:                 visited[member->type.value] = true;
  2619:                 work[work_count++] = member->type;

  2823:     scratch_end(temporary);
  2824:     return valid;
  2825: }

  2833: 
  2834: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_parse_matching_delimiter(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 open, u32 end, CPunctuator opening, CPunctuator closing)
  2835: {
  2836:     // The windowed shape scan, with this caller's own spelling of "no match":
  2837:     // `end` rather than the sentinel, for both an unbalanced closer and a
  2838:     // range that never returns to depth zero.
  2839: #if BUSTER_C_LEX_COMPACT
  2840:     CTokenShape const* shapes = c_preprocess_token_shapes(&preprocess);
  2841:     if (BUSTER_LIKELY(shapes != 0))
  2842:     {
  2843:         u32 match = c_shape_matching_delimiter(shapes, open, end, opening, closing);
  2844:         return match == UINT32_MAX ? end : match;
  2845:     }
  2846: #endif
  2847:     // The pair is loop-invariant, so it becomes one set the scan tests each
  2848:     // token against; see c_ir_matching_delimiter for the same shape.
  2849:     u64 delimiters = C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(opening) | C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(closing);
  2850:     u32 depth = 0;
  2851:     for (u32 index = open; index < end; index += 1)
  2852:     {
  2853:         u8 punctuator = preprocess.tokens[index].punctuator;
  2854:         if (c_punctuator_in_set(punctuator, delimiters))
  2855:         {
  2856:             if (punctuator == opening)
  2857:             {
  2858:                 depth += 1;
  2859:             }
  2860:             else
  2861:             {
  2862:                 if (!depth)
  2863:                 {
  2864:                     return end;
  2865:                 }
  2866:                 depth -= 1;
  2867:                 if (!depth)
  2868:                 {
  2869:                     return index;
  2870:                 }
  2871:             }
  2872:         }
  2873:     }
  2874:     return end;
  2875: }
  2876: 
  2877: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_expression_scalar_type(CParseResult* result, CTypeKind kind)
  2878: {
  2879:     return c_parse_add_type(result, (CType){
  2880:                                         .element_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
  2881:                                         .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
  2882:                                         .unqualified_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
  2883:                                         .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
  2884:                                         .kind = kind,
  2885:                                         .is_complete = true,
  2886:                                     });
  2887: }
  2888: 
  2889: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_expression_integer_kind(CTypeKind kind)
  2890: {
  2891:     return kind == C_TYPE_BOOL || kind == C_TYPE_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_SHORT ||
  2892:            kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT || kind == C_TYPE_INT || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT || kind == C_TYPE_LONG || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG ||
  2893:            kind == C_TYPE_LONG_LONG || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG || kind == C_TYPE_INT128 || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128 || kind == C_TYPE_ENUM;
  2894: }
  2895: 
  2896: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_expression_signed_kind(CTypeKind kind)
  2897: {
  2898:     return kind == C_TYPE_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_SHORT || kind == C_TYPE_INT || kind == C_TYPE_LONG || kind == C_TYPE_LONG_LONG ||
  2899:            kind == C_TYPE_INT128 || kind == C_TYPE_ENUM;
  2900: }
  2901: 
  2902: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeKind c_parse_expression_unsigned_kind(CTypeKind kind)
  2903: {
  2904:     switch (kind)
  2905:     {
  2906:     case C_TYPE_CHAR:
  2907:     case C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR:
  2908:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR:
  2909:         return C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR;
  2910:     case C_TYPE_SHORT:
  2911:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT:
  2912:         return C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT;
  2913:     case C_TYPE_INT:
  2914:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT:
  2915:     case C_TYPE_ENUM:
  2916:         return C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT;
  2917:     case C_TYPE_LONG:
  2918:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG:
  2919:         return C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG;
  2920:     case C_TYPE_LONG_LONG:
  2921:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG:
  2922:         return C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG;
  2923:     case C_TYPE_INT128:
  2924:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128:
  2925:         return C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128;
  2926:     case C_TYPE_INVALID:
  2927:     case C_TYPE_VOID:
  2928:     case C_TYPE_BOOL:
  2929:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT16:
  2930:     case C_TYPE_BFLOAT16:
  2931:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT:
  2932:     case C_TYPE_DOUBLE:
  2933:     case C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE:
  2934:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT16_COMPLEX:
  2935:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPLEX:
  2936:     case C_TYPE_DOUBLE_COMPLEX:
  2937:     case C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX:
  2938:     case C_TYPE_VA_LIST:
  2939:     case C_TYPE_NULLPTR:
  2940:     case C_TYPE_POINTER:
  2941:     case C_TYPE_ARRAY:
  2942:     case C_TYPE_VECTOR:
  2943:     case C_TYPE_FUNCTION:
  2944:     case C_TYPE_STRUCT:
  2945:     case C_TYPE_UNION:
  2946:     case C_TYPE_COUNT:
  2947:         return C_TYPE_INVALID;
  2948:     }
  2949:     return C_TYPE_INVALID;
  2950: }
  2951: 
  2952: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeKind c_parse_expression_promoted_kind(CTypeKind kind)
  2953: {
  2954:     if (kind == C_TYPE_BOOL || kind == C_TYPE_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_SHORT ||
  2955:         kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT || kind == C_TYPE_ENUM)
  2956:     {
  2957:         return C_TYPE_INT;
  2958:     }
  2959:     return kind;
  2960: }
  2961: 
  2962: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_expression_arithmetic_type(CParseResult* result, Target target, CTypeId left_id, CTypeId right_id)
  2963: {
  2964:     if (left_id.value >= result->type_count || right_id.value >= result->type_count)
  2965:     {
  2966:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2967:     }
  2968:     CTypeKind left = result->types[left_id.value].kind;
  2969:     CTypeKind right = result->types[right_id.value].kind;
  2970:     if (left == C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE || right == C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE)
  2971:     {
  2972:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE);
  2973:     }
  2974:     if (left == C_TYPE_DOUBLE || right == C_TYPE_DOUBLE)
  2975:     {
  2976:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, C_TYPE_DOUBLE);
  2977:     }
  2978:     if (left == C_TYPE_FLOAT || right == C_TYPE_FLOAT)
  2979:     {
  2980:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, C_TYPE_FLOAT);
  2981:     }
  2982:     // `_Float16` ranks below every other real floating type, so it only wins
  2983:     // once the three above have declined: `h * h` and `h * i` are `_Float16`,
  2984:     // while `h * f` is `float`. C23 6.3.1.8p1 gives it that rank and clang
  2985:     // computes the same result type.
  2986:     if (left == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 || right == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 || left == C_TYPE_BFLOAT16 || right == C_TYPE_BFLOAT16)
  2987:     {
  2988:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, left == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 || right == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 ? C_TYPE_FLOAT16 : C_TYPE_BFLOAT16);
  2989:     }
  2990:     if (!c_parse_expression_integer_kind(left) || !c_parse_expression_integer_kind(right))
  2991:     {
  2992:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2993:     }
  2994:     left = c_parse_expression_promoted_kind(left);
  2995:     right = c_parse_expression_promoted_kind(right);
  2996:     u64 left_size = 0;
  2997:     u64 right_size = 0;
  2998:     u32 ignored_alignment = 0;
  2999:     if (!c_parse_builtin_type_layout(target, left, &left_size, &ignored_alignment) ||
  3000:         !c_parse_builtin_type_layout(target, right, &right_size, &ignored_alignment))
  3001:     {
  3002:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  3003:     }
  3004:     CTypeKind result_kind = left;
  3005:     bool left_signed = c_parse_expression_signed_kind(left);
  3006:     bool right_signed = c_parse_expression_signed_kind(right);
  3007:     if (left_signed == right_signed)
  3008:     {
  3009:         if (right_size > left_size || (right_size == left_size && (u32)right > (u32)left))
  3010:         {
  3011:             result_kind = right;
  3012:         }
  3013:     }
  3014:     else
  3015:     {
  3016:         CTypeKind signed_kind = left_signed ? left : right;
  3017:         CTypeKind unsigned_kind = left_signed ? right : left;
  3018:         u64 signed_size = left_signed ? left_size : right_size;
  3019:         u64 unsigned_size = left_signed ? right_size : left_size;
  3020:         if (unsigned_size >= signed_size)
  3021:         {
  3022:             result_kind = unsigned_kind;
  3023:         }
  3024:         else
  3025:         {
  3026:             result_kind = signed_kind;
  3027:         }
  3028:         if (signed_size == unsigned_size && c_parse_expression_signed_kind(result_kind))
  3029:         {
  3030:             result_kind = c_parse_expression_unsigned_kind(result_kind);
  3031:         }
  3032:     }
  3033:     return result_kind == C_TYPE_INVALID ? C_TYPE_ID_INVALID : c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, result_kind);
  3034: }
  3035: 
  3036: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_expression_token_ends_operand(CToken token)
  3037: {
  3038:     return token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER || token.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER || token.kind == C_TOKEN_CHARACTER_LITERAL ||
  3039:            token.kind == C_TOKEN_STRING_LITERAL || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) ||
  3040:            c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE) ||
  3041:            c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS);
  3042: }
  3043: 
  3044: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_parse_expression_operator_precedence(CToken token)

  3285: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_type_parse_sizeof_step(CTypeParseMachine* machine, CTypeParseFrame* frame)
  3286: {
  3287:     Arena* arena = frame->arena;
  3288:     CPreprocessResult preprocess = frame->preprocess;
  3289:     CParseResult* result = frame->result;
  3290:     CScopeId scope = frame->scope;
  3291:     u32 start = frame->start;
  3292:     u32 end = frame->end;
  3293:     if (start >= end)
  3294:     {
  3295:         c_type_parse_frame_complete(machine, C_TYPE_ID_INVALID, start, false);
  3296:         return;
  3297:     }
  3298:     if (frame->stage == C_TYPE_PARSE_STAGE_BEGIN)
  3299:     {
  3300:         u32 task_range = end - start;
  3301:         u32 task_required = task_range + 1;
  3302:         if (task_range == UINT32_MAX || machine->expression_task_count > machine->expression_task_capacity ||
  3303:             task_required > machine->expression_task_capacity - machine->expression_task_count)
  3304:         {
  3305:             machine->failed = true;
  3306:             c_type_parse_frame_complete(machine, C_TYPE_ID_INVALID, start, false);
  3307:             return;
  3308:         }
  3309:         frame->task_capacity = task_required;
  3310:         frame->task_mark = machine->expression_task_count;
  3311:         frame->arena_mark = machine->scratch_arena->position;
  3312:         frame->expression_tasks = machine->expression_tasks + machine->expression_task_count;
  3313:         machine->expression_task_count += frame->task_capacity;
  3314:         frame->task_count = 1;
  3315:         frame->expression_tasks[0] = (CParseExpressionTypeTask){
  3316:             .start = start,
  3317:             .end = end,
  3318:         };
  3319:         frame->type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  3320:         frame->stage = C_TYPE_PARSE_STAGE_FINISH;
  3321:     }
  3322:     else if (frame->stage == C_TYPE_PARSE_STAGE_CHILD)
  3323:     {
  3324:         frame->type = machine->result_valid ? machine->result_type : C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  3325:         frame->task_count -= 1;
  3326:         frame->stage = C_TYPE_PARSE_STAGE_FINISH;
  3327:     }
  3328:     CParseExpressionTypeTask* tasks = frame->expression_tasks;
  3329:     u32 task_count = frame->task_count;
  3330:     u32 capacity = frame->task_capacity;
  3331:     CTypeId last = frame->type;
  3332:     while (task_count)
  3333:     {
  3334:         CParseExpressionTypeTask* task = tasks + task_count - 1;
  3335:         if (!task->state)
  3336:         {
  3337:             while (task->start < task->end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[task->start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
  3338:                    c_parse_matching_delimiter_indexed(result, preprocess, task->start) ==
  3339:                        task->end - 1)
  3340:             {
  3341:                 task->start += 1;
  3342:                 task->end -= 1;
  3343:                 task->operators_checked = false;
  3344:             }
  3345:             if (task->start >= task->end)
  3346:             {
  3347:                 last = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  3348:                 task_count -= 1;
  3349:                 continue;
  3350:             }
  3351:             CToken first = preprocess.tokens[task->start];
  3352:             if (c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS) ||
  3353:                 c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_TILDE) || c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_EXCLAMATION) ||
  3354:                 c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS))
  3355:             {
  3356:                 // An increment keeps its operand's type -- no promotion,
  3357:                 // pointers allowed -- where `+`/`-`/`~` promote and demand
  3358:                 // an arithmetic operand: `__typeof__(++p)` over a pointer is
  3359:                 // that pointer, and Py_CLEAR's `*p++` depends on it.
  3360:                 task->operation = c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_EXCLAMATION) ? C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_LOGICAL_NOT
  3361:                                   : (c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS))
  3362:                                       ? C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_UPDATE
  3363:                                       : C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_UNARY;
  3364:                 task->state = 1;
  3365:                 if (task_count >= capacity)
  3366:                 {
  3367:                     last = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  3368:                     break;
  3369:                 }
  3370:                 tasks[task_count++] = (CParseExpressionTypeTask){
  3371:                     .start = task->start + 1,
  3372:                     .end = task->end,
  3373:                     .operators_checked = task->operators_checked,
  3374:                 };
  3375:                 continue;
  3376:             }
  3377:             u32 best_precedence = UINT32_MAX;
  3378:             u32 best_operator = task->end;
  3379:             u32 question = task->end;
  3380:             u32 colon = task->end;
  3381:             u32 nested_questions = 0;
  3382:             u32 cast_prefix_close = UINT32_MAX;
  3383:             for (u32 index = task->start; !task->operators_checked && index < task->end; index += 1)
  3384:             {
  3385:                 CToken token = preprocess.tokens[index];

  3387:                     c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
  3388:                 {
  3389:                     u32 close = c_parse_matching_delimiter_indexed(result, preprocess, index);
  3390:                     if (close >= task->end)
  3391:                     {

  3393:                     }

  3395:                         (index == task->start || index - 1 == cast_prefix_close ||
  3396:                          !c_parse_expression_token_ends_operand(preprocess.tokens[index - 1])))
  3397:                     {
  3398:                         u32 type_index = index + 1;
  3399:                         CTypeId cast = c_parse_machineless_base_type(result, preprocess, scope, index + 1, close, &type_index);
  3400:                         if (cast.value < result->type_count)
  3401:                         {
  3402:                             cast = c_parse_pointer_chain(result, preprocess, cast, &type_index, close);
  3403:                             if (cast.value < result->type_count && type_index == close) cast_prefix_close = close;
  3404:                         }
  3405:                     }

  3599:         }

  3602:         if (left.value >= result->type_count || right.value >= result->type_count)

  3605:             task_count -= 1;

  3607:         }

  3609:         CType* right_type = result->types + right.value;

  3615:             // top-level qualifiers disappear. Bare typeof operands keep them.
  3616:             last = c_parse_auto_decay_type(result, right);
  3617:         }
  3618:         break;
  3619:         case C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_ASSIGN:
  3620:         {
  3621:             last = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, left);
  3622:         }
  3623:         break;
  3624:         case C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_COMPARE:
  3625:         {
  3626:             last = c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, C_TYPE_INT);
  3627:         }
  3628:         break;
  3629:         case C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_SHIFT:
  3630:         {
  3631:             CTypeKind kind = c_parse_expression_promoted_kind(left_type->kind);
  3632:             last = c_parse_expression_integer_kind(kind) ? c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, kind) : C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  3633:         }
  3634:         break;
  3635:         case C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_ARITHMETIC:
  3636:         {
  3637:             CToken operation = preprocess.tokens[task->split];
  3638:             bool add_or_subtract = c_token_is_punctuator(&operation, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&operation, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
  3639:             if (add_or_subtract && left_type->kind == C_TYPE_POINTER && c_parse_expression_integer_kind(right_type->kind))
  3640:             {
  3641:                 last = left;
  3642:             }
  3643:             else if (add_or_subtract && right_type->kind == C_TYPE_POINTER && c_parse_expression_integer_kind(left_type->kind) &&
  3644:                      c_token_is_punctuator(&operation, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS))
  3645:             {
  3646:                 last = right;
  3647:             }

  3649:             {
  3650:                 last = c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, target_uses_llp64_data_model(preprocess.target) ? C_TYPE_LONG_LONG : C_TYPE_LONG);
  3651:             }
  3652:             else
  3653:             {
  3654:                 last = c_parse_expression_arithmetic_type(result, preprocess.target, left, right);
  3655:             }
  3656:         }
  3657:         break;
  3658:         case C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_CONDITIONAL:
  3659:         {
  3660:             // The arms' token ranges travel with the type ids because C
  3661:             // resolves two mismatched pointer operands by *spelling*: an
  3662:             // operand that is a null pointer constant yields the other one's
  3663:             // type, and only the ranges can say whether one is.

  3665:                                                        task->end);
  3666:         }
  3667:         break;
  3668:         case C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_NONE:
  3669:         case C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_UNARY:
  3670:         case C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_UPDATE:
  3671:         case C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_LOGICAL_NOT:
  3672:         case C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_INDIRECTION:
  3673:         case C_PARSE_EXPRESSION_TYPE_ADDRESS_OF:
  3674:         {
  3675:             last = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  3676:         }
  3677:         break;
  3678:         }
  3679:         task_count -= 1;
  3680:     }
  3681:     if (last.value >= result->type_count)
  3682:     {
  3683:         c_type_parse_frame_complete(machine, C_TYPE_ID_INVALID, start, false);
  3684:         return;
  3685:     }
  3686:     c_type_parse_frame_complete(machine, last, end, true);
  3687: }

  3689: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_expression_type_query(CTypeParseMachine* machine, Arena* arena, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result,
  3690:                                                        CScopeId scope, u32 start, u32 end, CTypeId* type_out)
  3691: {
  3692:     u32 frame_start = machine->frame_count;

  3694:     u32 mutation_mark = machine->mutation_count;
  3695:     machine->mutation_type_limit = checkpoint.type_count;
  3696:     machine->result_valid = false;
  3697:     bool pushed = c_type_parse_frame_push(machine, (CTypeParseFrame){
  3698:                                               .result = result,
  3699:                                               .preprocess = preprocess,
  3700:                                               .arena = arena,
  3701:                                               .scope = scope,
  3702:                                               .start = start,
  3703:                                               .end = end,
  3704:                                               .kind = C_TYPE_PARSE_FRAME_SIZEOF,
  3705:                                           });
  3706:     if (pushed)
  3707:     {
  3708:         c_type_parse_machine_run(machine, frame_start);
  3709:     }
  3710:     bool valid = c_type_parse_root_finish(machine, result, checkpoint, mutation_mark,
  3711:                                           start < preprocess.token_count ? c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, preprocess.tokens[start]) : (CSourceLocation){0});
  3712:     if (valid)
  3713:     {
  3714:         *type_out = machine->result_type;
  3715:     }
  3716:     return valid;
  3717: }

  3726: // Resolve one generic selection while the parse-side integer evaluators are

  3733:                                                          CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope, u32 start, u32 end,

  3738:                  c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS);

  3765:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
  3766:         {
  3767:             braces += 1;
  3768:         }

  3770:         {

  4342:             tokens[token_count++] = token;

  4356:             }

  4360:             }

  4362:                                                   C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER, C_PUNCTUATOR_NONE);
  4363:             continue;
  4364:         }
  4365:         tokens[token_count++] = c_space_retoken(&evaluation_space, preprocess.spelling_base, token);
  4366:     }
  4367:     CPreprocessResult evaluation = {
  4368:         .diagnostics = arena_allocate(arena, CDiagnostic, token_count + 1),
  4369:         .target = preprocess.target,
  4370:         .dialect = preprocess.dialect,
  4371:     };

  4373: }

  4375: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_integer_constant_range(CTypeParseMachine* machine, Arena* arena, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result,
  4376:                                                         CScopeId scope, u32 start, u32 end, u64* value_out)

  4386:     // no diagnostic path reads (the expression tokens keep their own).

  4396:         .punctuator = C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS,
  4397:     };
  4398:     memcpy(tokens + 2, preprocess.tokens + start, sizeof(*tokens) * expression_count);
  4399:     tokens[expression_count + 2] = (CToken){
  4400:         .offset = C_SPELLING_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS,
  4401:         .length = 1,
  4402:         .kind = C_TOKEN_PUNCTUATOR,
  4403:         .punctuator = C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS,
  4404:     };
  4405:     tokens[expression_count + 3] = (CToken){
  4406:         .offset = C_SPELLING_SEMICOLON,
  4407:         .length = 1,
  4408:         .kind = C_TOKEN_PUNCTUATOR,
  4409:         .punctuator = C_PUNCTUATOR_SEMICOLON,
  4410:     };

  4413:     synthetic.token_count = expression_count + 4;
  4414:     String8 ignored_message = {0};

  4416:                                           (CDeclaration){
  4417:                                               .token_count = expression_count + 4,
  4418:                                           },
  4419:                                           scope, value_out, &ignored_message);
  4420: }
  4421: 
  4422: // C11 6.3.2.3p3 gives a null pointer constant two spellings: an integer
  4423: // constant expression with the value 0, or such an expression cast to
  4424: // `void *`.  The second is the only one that survives as a conditional
  4425: // operand, and it is what musl's <tgmath.h> selects a type with --
  4426: // `0 ? (t *)0 : (void *)!(c)` names `t` exactly when the `void *` arm is one.
  4427: //
  4428: // The type gate is not a shortcut, it is the whole correctness of the answer:
  4429: // the constant walk below strips every cast before evaluating, so
  4430: // `(double *)0` folds to zero just as `(void *)0` does, and without the gate
  4431: // any zero-valued pointer cast would claim to be a null pointer constant.
  4432: // The walk is entered machineless -- the caller is already inside a type-parse
  4433: // frame -- so an operand whose value needs the machine (a `sizeof` over a type
  4434: // only a frame can resolve) simply answers no, which is the conservative half.
  4435: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_range_is_null_pointer_constant(Arena* arena, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope,
  4436:                                                                 CTypeId type_id, u32 start, u32 end)
  4437: {
  4438:     type_id = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, type_id);
  4439:     bool constant = false;
  4440:     if (type_id.value < result->type_count && start < end)
  4441:     {
  4442:         // By value: c_parse_unqualified_type may append a type and move the
  4443:         // table out from under a borrowed row.
  4444:         CType type = result->types[type_id.value];
  4445:         bool void_pointer = false;
  4446:         if (type.kind == C_TYPE_POINTER)
  4447:         {
  4448:             CTypeId element = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, type.element_type);
  4449:             void_pointer = element.value < result->type_count && result->types[element.value].kind == C_TYPE_VOID;
  4450:         }
  4451:         if (void_pointer || c_parse_expression_integer_kind(type.kind))
  4452:         {
  4453:             // Strip the pointer casts in front of the constant by shape, not
  4454:             // by resolving them: a parenthesized group whose last token is
  4455:             // `*` is never a parenthesized expression, so it can only be a
  4456:             // pointer cast.  The walk below resolves a cast type of its own,
  4457:             // but only through the machineless base-type reader, which cannot
  4458:             // read the `(__typeof__(...) *)` musl's `__type2` writes around
  4459:             // its inner `__type1` -- and one unstripped cast is the whole
  4460:             // answer, because the operand it hides is the literal `0`.
  4461:             while (start < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
  4462:             {
  4463:                 u32 close = c_parse_matching_delimiter(preprocess, start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
  4464:                 if (close + 1 >= end || close < start + 2 || !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[close - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR))
  4465:                 {
  4466:                     break;
  4467:                 }
  4468:                 start = close + 1;
  4469:             }
  4470:             u64 value = 0;
  4471:             constant = c_parse_integer_constant_range(0, arena, preprocess, result, scope, start, end, &value) && !value;
  4472:         }
  4473:     }
  4474:     return constant;
  4475: }

  6649: BUSTER_C_SHARED CTypeId c_parse_pointer_chain(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CTypeId base, u32* index, u32 end);

  6653: // How many parent links separate `scope` from `candidate`, or UINT32_MAX when
  6654: // `candidate` is not `scope` or one of its ancestors.  Distance is what makes
  6655: // the innermost visible tag win the scan below.
  6656: BUSTER_C_SHARED u32 c_parse_scope_distance(CParseResult* result, CScopeId candidate, CScopeId scope)
  6657: {
  6658:     // A type recorded without a scope -- a hand-built result, or a parse that
  6659:     // ran before the scope table existed -- reads as the file scope, which is
  6660:     // scope zero whenever there are scopes at all.
  6661:     if (candidate.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6662:     {
  6663:         candidate = (CScopeId){0};
  6664:     }
  6665:     u32 distance = 0;
  6666:     while (scope.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && scope.value < result->scope_count)
  6667:     {
  6668:         if (scope.value == candidate.value)
  6669:         {
  6670:             return distance;
  6671:         }
  6672:         scope = result->scopes[scope.value].parent;
  6673:         distance += 1;
  6674:     }
  6675:     return UINT32_MAX;
  6676: }
  6677: 
  6678: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_aggregate_lookup(CParseResult* result, CTypeKind kind, String8 tag, CScopeId scope)
  6679: {
  6680:     CTypeId found = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  6681:     if (tag.length)
  6682:     {
  6683:         CAggregateLookup* lookup = result->aggregate_lookup;
  6684:         bool scan = !lookup;
  6685:         bool scan_by_scope = false;
  6686:         if (lookup)
  6687:         {
  6688:             CAggregateLookupSlot* slot = c_parse_aggregate_lookup_slot(lookup, kind, tag);
  6689:             scan = lookup->incomplete;
  6690:             scan_by_scope = lookup->incomplete;
  6691:             if (slot->used)
  6692:             {
  6693:                 u32 type_index = slot->type_index;
  6694:                 bool live = type_index < result->type_count && result->types[type_index].kind == kind &&
  6695:                     !result->types[type_index].has_unqualified_type && string_equal(result->types[type_index].tag, tag);
  6696:                 if (live && !slot->multiple)
  6697:                 {
  6698:                     found = (CTypeId){.value = type_index};
  6699:                     scan = false;
  6700:                 }
  6701:                 else
  6702:                 {
  6703:                     scan = true;
  6704:                     scan_by_scope = scan_by_scope || slot->multiple;
  6705:                 }
  6706:             }
  6707:         }
  6708:         if (scan)
  6709:         {
  6710:             // Duplicate scoped tags retain their established resolution:
  6711:             // innermost visible type, latest at equal depth; without a scope,
  6712:             // the oldest unqualified match. Stale slots validate live rows.
  6713:             u32 best_distance = UINT32_MAX;
  6714:             bool scoped = scan_by_scope && scope.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
  6715:             for (u32 type_index = 0; type_index < result->type_count; type_index += 1)
  6716:             {
  6717:                 C_AGGREGATE_LOOKUP_COUNT(lookup, fallback_type_count);
  6718:                 CType* type = &result->types[type_index];
  6719:                 if (type->kind == kind && !type->has_unqualified_type && string_equal(type->tag, tag))
  6720:                 {
  6721:                     if (!scoped)
  6722:                     {
  6723:                         found = (CTypeId){.value = type_index};
  6724:                         break;
  6725:                     }
  6726:                     u32 distance = c_parse_scope_distance(result, type->tag_scope, scope);
  6727:                     if (distance != UINT32_MAX && distance <= best_distance)
  6728:                     {
  6729:                         found = (CTypeId){.value = type_index};
  6730:                         best_distance = distance;
  6731:                     }
  6732:                 }
  6733:             }
  6734:         }
  6735:     }
  6736:     return found;
  6737: }
  6738: 
  6739: #undef C_AGGREGATE_LOOKUP_COUNT

  7575: // Does the identifier at `index` name a type on its own?  The answer comes
  7576: // from c_ir_primitive_type_kind run over that one token: a word the scan
  7577: // collects names a type, and a qualifier, storage class or function
  7578: // specifier it steps over does not -- so the question is asked of the same
  7579: // ladder the specifier sets are built from and no second list of spellings
  7580: // can drift from it.  A tag keyword names a type through the aggregate
  7581: // branch rather than the scan, and is read from the well-known set that
  7582: // branch already tests.  Callers ask it of a word standing beside a type
  7583: // that is spelled some other way, where a second type specifier is the
  7584: // constraint violation C_DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID_TYPE_SPECIFIERS reports.
  7585: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_specifier_token(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 index)
  7586: {
  7587:     u32 declarator_start = index;
  7588:     u32 invalid_specifier = UINT32_MAX;
  7589:     CTypeKind kind = c_ir_primitive_type_kind(preprocess, index, index + 1, &declarator_start, &invalid_specifier);
  7590:     return kind != C_TYPE_INVALID || invalid_specifier != UINT32_MAX ||
  7591:            c_token_in_well_known_set(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index], C_PARSE_AGGREGATE_KEYWORDS);
  7592: }
  7593: 
  7594: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_parse_attribute_unsigned(String8 spelling, u32* value_out)
  7595: {
  7596:     u32 base = 10;
  7597:     u64 index = 0;
  7598:     if (spelling.length > 2 && spelling.pointer[0] == '0' && (spelling.pointer[1] == 'x' || spelling.pointer[1] == 'X'))
  7599:     {
  7600:         base = 16;
  7601:         index = 2;
  7602:     }
  7603:     u32 value = 0;
  7604:     bool any = false;
  7605:     for (; index < spelling.length; index += 1)
  7606:     {
  7607:         char8 character = spelling.pointer[index];
  7608:         u32 digit = character >= '0' && character <= '9'   ? (u32)(character - '0')
  7609:                     : character >= 'a' && character <= 'f' ? (u32)(character - 'a') + 10
  7610:                     : character >= 'A' && character <= 'F' ? (u32)(character - 'A') + 10
  7611:                                                            : UINT32_MAX;
  7612:         if (digit >= base)
  7613:         {
  7614:             break;
  7615:         }
  7616:         if (value > (UINT32_MAX - digit) / base)
  7617:         {
  7618:             return false;
  7619:         }
  7620:         value = value * base + digit;
  7621:         any = true;
  7622:     }
  7623:     while (index < spelling.length &&
  7624:            (spelling.pointer[index] == 'u' || spelling.pointer[index] == 'U' || spelling.pointer[index] == 'l' || spelling.pointer[index] == 'L'))
  7625:     {
  7626:         index += 1;
  7627:     }
  7628:     if (!any || index != spelling.length)
  7629:     {
  7630:         return false;
  7631:     }
  7632:     *value_out = value;
  7633:     return true;
  7634: }
  7635: 
  7636: // The byte count of one `vector_size ( ... )` occurrence, with `index` at the
  7637: // attribute spelling. A lone integer literal resolves without the constant
  7638: // machinery; anything else â `16 * sizeof(float)` is the shape GCC's own
  7639: // documentation uses â evaluates as an integer constant expression. Callers
  7640: // include type-parse machine steps, which cannot reenter the machine, so the
  7641: // evaluation always takes the machineless path.
  7642: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_vector_size_argument(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, u32 index, u32 end, u32* value_out)
  7643: {
  7644:     if (index + 3 >= end || !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
  7645:     {
  7646:         return false;
  7647:     }
  7648:     if (preprocess.tokens[index + 2].kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER &&
  7649:         c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index + 3], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) &&
  7650:         c_parse_attribute_unsigned(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index + 2]), value_out))
  7651:     {
  7652:         return true;
  7653:     }
  7654:     u32 close = c_parse_matching_delimiter(preprocess, index + 1, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
  7655:     bool result_value = false;
  7656:     if (close < end && close > index + 2)
  7657:     {
  7658:         TemporalArena temporary = scratch_begin(&result->arena, 1);
  7659:         u64 value = 0;
  7660:         if (c_parse_integer_constant_range(0, temporary.arena, preprocess, result, scope, index + 2, close, &value) && value && value <= UINT32_MAX)
  7661:         {
  7662:             *value_out = (u32)value;
  7663:             result_value = true;
  7664:         }
  7665:         scratch_end(temporary);
  7666:     }
  7667:     return result_value;
  7668: }

  7670: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_apply_vector_attribute(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, CTypeId base, u32 start,
  7671:                                                            u32 end)
  7672: {
  7673:     u32 vector_byte_size = 0;
  7674:     if (result->position_index && !result->position_index->built)
  7675:     {
  7676:         c_parse_position_index_build(result, preprocess);
  7677:     }
  7678:     if (result->position_index)
  7679:     {
  7680:         u32 cursor = start;
  7681:         while (cursor + 3 < end)
  7682:         {
  7683:             u32 index =
  7684:                 c_parse_first_position_in_range(result->position_index->vector_size_positions, result->position_index->vector_size_count, cursor, end - 3);
  7685:             if (index == UINT32_MAX)
  7686:             {
  7687:                 break;
  7688:             }
  7689:             if (c_parse_vector_size_argument(result, preprocess, scope, index, end, &vector_byte_size))
  7690:             {
  7691:                 break;
  7692:             }
  7693:             vector_byte_size = 0;
  7694:             cursor = index + 1;
  7695:         }
  7696:     }
  7697:     else
  7698:     {
  7699:         for (u32 index = start; index + 3 < end; index += 1)
  7700:         {
  7701:             if (preprocess.tokens[index].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER ||
  7702:                 !(c_parse_token_class_compute(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index])) & C_TOKEN_CLASS_VECTOR_SIZE) ||
  7703:                 !c_parse_vector_size_argument(result, preprocess, scope, index, end, &vector_byte_size))
  7704:             {
  7705:                 continue;
  7706:             }
  7707:             break;
  7708:         }
  7709:     }
  7710:     if (!vector_byte_size)
  7711:     {
  7712:         return base;
  7713:     }
  7714:     if (base.value >= result->type_count)
  7715:     {
  7716:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  7717:     }
  7718:     CTypeKind base_kind = result->types[base.value].kind;
  7719:     // GNU's vector_size accepts any integer or floating element; `_Float16`
  7720:     // joins the ladder because clang's `avx512fp16intrin.h` builds `__m512h`,
  7721:     // `__m256h` and `__m128h` out of it.
  7722:     bool arithmetic = (base_kind >= C_TYPE_CHAR && base_kind <= C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128) || base_kind == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 || base_kind == C_TYPE_BFLOAT16 ||
  7723:                       base_kind == C_TYPE_FLOAT || base_kind == C_TYPE_DOUBLE;
  7724:     if (!arithmetic)
  7725:     {
  7726:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  7727:     }
  7728:     return c_parse_add_type(result, (CType){
  7729:                                         .element_type = base,
  7730:                                         .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
  7731:                                         .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
  7732:                                         .vector_byte_size = vector_byte_size,
  7733:                                         .kind = C_TYPE_VECTOR,
  7734:                                         .is_complete = true,
  7735:                                     });
  7736: }

  7740: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_qualified_typedef_type(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, u32 start, u32 end,
  7741:                                                            u32* declarator_start)
  7742: {
  7743:     CType qualifiers = {
  7744:         .element_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
  7745:         .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
  7746:         .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
  7747:     };
  7748:     bool has_qualifier = false;
  7749:     u32 typedef_index = start;
  7750:     while (typedef_index < end && preprocess.tokens[typedef_index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
  7751:     {
  7752:         u32 alignment_end = c_parse_skip_alignment_specifiers(preprocess, typedef_index, end);
  7753:         if (alignment_end != typedef_index)
  7754:         {
  7755:             typedef_index = c_parse_skip_attributes(preprocess, alignment_end, end);
  7756:             continue;
  7757:         }
  7758:         if (c_parse_type_qualifier_word_token(preprocess, preprocess.tokens[typedef_index], &qualifiers))
  7759:         {
  7760:             has_qualifier = true;
  7761:         }
  7762:         else if (!c_parse_atomic_declaration_prefix_token(preprocess, preprocess.tokens[typedef_index], &qualifiers))
  7763:         {
  7764:             break;
  7765:         }
  7766:         typedef_index += 1;
  7767:         typedef_index = c_parse_skip_attributes(preprocess, typedef_index, end);
  7768:     }
  7769:     if (typedef_index >= end)
  7770:     {
  7771:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  7772:     }
  7773:     // A type word -- `int`, `void`, `struct` and the rest of the keyword
  7774:     // family -- names no typedef, and the word bits say so in one load;
  7775:     // only a name pays the scope chain and, after it, the typedef table.
  7776:     CToken typedef_token = preprocess.tokens[typedef_index];
  7777:     CTypeId type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  7778:     if (!c_parse_type_word_for_dialect_token(preprocess, typedef_token))
  7779:     {
  7780:         CEntityId typedef_entity = c_parse_lookup_entity_token(result, preprocess.spelling_base, scope, &typedef_token);
  7781:         if (typedef_entity.value < result->entity_count && result->entities[typedef_entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF)
  7782:         {
  7783:             type = result->entities[typedef_entity.value].type;
  7784:         }
  7785:         else if (typedef_entity.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  7786:         {
  7787:             typedef_entity = c_parse_lookup_typedef_name_token(result, preprocess.spelling_base, typedef_token, true);
  7788:             if (typedef_entity.value < result->entity_count && result->entities[typedef_entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF)
  7789:             {
  7790:                 type = result->entities[typedef_entity.value].type;
  7791:             }
  7792:         }
  7793:     }
  7794:     if (type.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  7795:     {
  7796:         u32 qualifier_index = typedef_index + 1;
  7797:         while (qualifier_index < end && preprocess.tokens[qualifier_index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
  7798:         {
  7799:             u32 alignment_end = c_parse_skip_alignment_specifiers(preprocess, qualifier_index, end);
  7800:             if (alignment_end != qualifier_index)
  7801:             {
  7802:                 qualifier_index = c_parse_skip_attributes(preprocess, alignment_end, end);
  7803:                 continue;
  7804:             }
  7805:             // A GNU attribute may follow the typedef name directly, with no
  7806:             // qualifier and no alignment specifier ahead of it to carry the
  7807:             // skip: musl's strlen and its eleven siblings write `typedef
  7808:             // size_t __attribute__((__may_alias__)) word;` in a *block*, where
  7809:             // this is the walk that says where the declarator starts.  Left
  7810:             // in, the attribute became the declared name and the declaration
  7811:             // was rejected.  The run stays inside the specifier range the
  7812:             // caller then hands to c_parse_alignment_specifiers, so an
  7813:             // `aligned` attribute here is still read.
  7814:             u32 attribute_end = c_parse_skip_attributes(preprocess, qualifier_index, end);
  7815:             if (attribute_end != qualifier_index)
  7816:             {
  7817:                 qualifier_index = attribute_end;
  7818:                 continue;
  7819:             }
  7820:             if (c_parse_type_qualifier_word_token(preprocess, preprocess.tokens[qualifier_index], &qualifiers))
  7821:             {
  7822:                 has_qualifier = true;
  7823:             }
  7824:             else if (!c_parse_atomic_declaration_prefix_token(preprocess, preprocess.tokens[qualifier_index], &qualifiers))
  7825:             {
  7826:                 break;
  7827:             }
  7828:             qualifier_index += 1;
  7829:             qualifier_index = c_parse_skip_attributes(preprocess, qualifier_index, end);
  7830:         }
  7831:         *declarator_start = qualifier_index;
  7832:         if (has_qualifier)
  7833:         {
  7834:             type = c_parse_add_qualified_type(result, type, qualifiers);
  7835:         }
  7836:     }
  7837: 
  7838:     return type;
  7839: }

  7844: // The dialect-independent storage/function-specifier words the atomic
  7845: // declaration prefix accepts besides the qualifiers; split out so
  7846: // c_parse_word_bits_compute can derive C_WORD_STORAGE_PREFIX from the same
  7847: // ladder the spelling path runs.
  7848: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_storage_prefix_word(String8 spelling)

  7851:            string_equal(spelling, S8("__inline")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__inline__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("_Noreturn")) ||
  7852:            string_equal(spelling, S8("register")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("static")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("typedef")) ||

  9853: // item list fills members rather than elements. Everything else answers
  9854: // zero and the caller stays unresolved, exactly as before the count.
  9855: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u64 c_parse_count_plain_initializer_items(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 start, u32 end, bool element_is_aggregate)
  9856: {
  9857:     u64 count = 0;
  9858:     if (start < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE) &&
  9859:         c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[end - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE))
  9860:     {
  9861:         u32 depth = 0;
  9862:         bool item_open = false;
  9863:         bool item_braced = false;
  9864:         bool valid = true;
  9865:         for (u32 index = start; valid && index < end; index += 1)
  9866:         {
  9867:             CToken token = preprocess.tokens[index];
  9868:             if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) ||
  9869:                 c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
  9870:             {
  9871:                 // A designator's bracket, or any bracket ahead of a value,
  9872:                 // makes the item count untrustworthy.
  9873:                 valid &= !c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) || depth != 1;
  9874:                 if (depth == 1 && !item_open)
  9875:                 {
  9876:                     item_open = true;
  9877:                     item_braced = c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE);
  9878:                 }
  9879:                 depth += 1;
  9880:             }
  9881:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET) ||
  9882:                      c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE))
  9883:             {
  9884:                 depth -= depth != 0;
  9885:             }
  9886:             else if (depth == 1)
  9887:             {
  9888:                 if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA))
  9889:                 {
  9890:                     count += item_open;
  9891:                     valid &= !item_open || !element_is_aggregate || item_braced;
  9892:                     item_open = false;
  9893:                     item_braced = false;
  9894:                 }
  9895:                 else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_ASSIGN))
  9896:                 {
  9897:                     valid = false;
  9898:                 }
  9899:                 else if (!item_open)
  9900:                 {
  9901:                     item_open = true;
  9902:                     item_braced = false;
  9903:                 }
  9904:             }
  9905:         }
  9906:         count += item_open;
  9907:         valid &= !item_open || !element_is_aggregate || item_braced;
  9908:         count = valid ? count : 0;
  9909:     }
  9910:     return count;
  9911: }
