  9913: // The expression shapes the enum-constant evaluator can apply sizeof or
  9914: // _Alignof to without the type-parse machine: an object, parameter, local,
  9915: // or enumerator name under redundant parentheses and leading dereferences,
  9916: // extended by a postfix chain of subscripts and member selections. Anything
  9917: // else stays unresolved and the caller fails the enumerator rather than
  9918: // guessing â but these shapes cover the array-length idiom
  9919: // `enum { N = sizeof(table) / sizeof(table[0]) }`, whose failure used to
  9920: // fail the whole enum type and leave every one of its enumerators
  9921: // undeclared in function bodies (found by tools/differential_c_harness.py,
  9922: // family enum_sizeof; tests/basic_c_enum_sizeof_object.c is the fixture).
  9923: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_sizeof_operand_expression_layout(Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope,
  9924:                                                                   u32 start, u32 end, u64* size_out, u32* alignment_out)
  9925: {
  9926:     bool stripping = true;
  9927:     while (stripping)
  9928:     {
  9929:         stripping = false;
  9930:         if (end > start + 1 && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
  9931:         {
  9932:             u32 depth = 0;
  9933:             u32 close = 0;
  9934:             for (u32 index = start; index < end && !close; index += 1)
  9935:             {
  9936:                 CToken token = preprocess.tokens[index];
  9937:                 if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
  9938:                 {
  9939:                     depth += 1;
  9940:                 }
  9941:                 else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
  9942:                 {
  9943:                     depth -= 1;
  9944:                     if (!depth)
  9945:                     {
  9946:                         close = index;
  9947:                     }
  9948:                 }
  9949:             }
  9950:             if (close == end - 1)
  9951:             {
  9952:                 start += 1;
  9953:                 end -= 1;
  9954:                 stripping = true;
  9955:             }
  9956:         }
  9957:     }
  9958:     u32 dereference_count = 0;
  9959:     while (start < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR))
  9960:     {
  9961:         dereference_count += 1;
  9962:         start += 1;
  9963:     }
  9964:     u32 identifier_index = start;
  9965:     u32 postfix_index = start < end ? start + 1 : start;
  9966:     if (start < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
  9967:     {

  9969:             c_parse_matching_delimiter(preprocess, start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
  9970:         if (primary_close < end && primary_close + 1 < end)
  9971:         {
  9972:             u32 primary_start = start + 1;
  9973:             u32 primary_end = primary_close;
  9974:             bool primary_stripping = true;
  9975:             while (primary_stripping)
  9976:             {
  9977:                 primary_stripping = false;

  9979:                     c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[primary_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
  9980:                 {

  9982:                                                                   C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS,
  9983:                                                                   C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
  9984:                     if (nested_close == primary_end - 1)
  9985:                     {
  9986:                         primary_start += 1;
  9987:                         primary_end -= 1;
  9988:                         primary_stripping = true;
  9989:                     }
  9990:                 }
  9991:             }
  9992:             if (primary_end == primary_start + 1 && preprocess.tokens[primary_start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
  9993:             {
  9994:                 identifier_index = primary_start;
  9995:                 postfix_index = primary_close + 1;
  9996:             }
  9997:         }
  9998:     }
  9999:     CTypeId type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10000:     bool is_enumerator = false;
 10001:     u32 declaration_index = UINT32_MAX;
 10002:     u32 index = start;
 10003:     if (identifier_index < end && preprocess.tokens[identifier_index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 10004:     {
 10005:         String8 name = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[identifier_index]);

 10056:                     depth -= 1;

 10059:                         close = cursor;

 10066:             index = valid ? close + 1 : index;
 10067:         }
 10068:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW))
 10069:         {
 10070:             if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW))
 10071:             {
 10072:                 valid = record->kind == C_TYPE_POINTER && record->element_type.value < result->type_count;
 10073:                 record = valid ? &result->types[record->element_type.value] : record;
 10074:             }
 10075:             valid = valid && index + 1 < end && preprocess.tokens[index + 1].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
 10076:                     (record->kind == C_TYPE_STRUCT || record->kind == C_TYPE_UNION);
 10077:             if (valid)
 10078:             {
 10079:                 String8 member_name = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index + 1]);
 10080:                 bool found_member = false;
 10081:                 for (u32 member_index = record->member_start; member_index < record->member_start + record->member_count && !found_member;
 10082:                      member_index += 1)
 10083:                 {
 10084:                     CMember* member = &result->members[member_index];
 10085:                     if (string_equal(member->name, member_name) && !member->is_bit_field)
 10086:                     {
 10087:                         type = member->type;
 10088:                         found_member = true;
 10089:                     }
 10090:                 }
 10091:                 valid = found_member;
 10092:             }
 10093:             index += valid ? 2 : 0;
 10094:         }
 10095:         else
 10096:         {
 10097:             valid = false;
 10098:         }
 10099:     }
 10100:     while (valid && dereference_count)
 10101:     {
 10102:         CType* record = type.value < result->type_count ? &result->types[type.value] : 0;
 10103:         valid = record && (record->kind == C_TYPE_POINTER || record->kind == C_TYPE_ARRAY);
 10104:         type = valid ? record->element_type : type;
 10105:         dereference_count -= 1;
 10106:     }
 10107:     // A bare object name whose type is an inferred-length array needs its
 10108:     // element count before c_parse_infer_file_array_bounds has run; count
 10109:     // the plain initializer shapes directly and keep the answer local to
 10110:     // this query, like every other inferred layout.
 10111:     u64 counted_items = 0;
 10112:     CTypeId counted_element = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10113:     if (valid && !dereference_count && index == start + 1 && index == end && type.value < result->type_count &&
 10114:         declaration_index < result->declaration_count)
 10115:     {
 10116:         CType* record = &result->types[type.value];
 10117:         bool unresolved_bound = record->kind == C_TYPE_ARRAY && record->array_bound < result->array_bound_count &&
 10118:                                 !result->array_bounds[record->array_bound].token_count &&
 10119:                                 !result->array_bounds[record->array_bound].has_inferred_count &&
 10120:                                 !result->array_bounds[record->array_bound].is_star;
 10121:         if (unresolved_bound)
 10122:         {
 10123:             CDeclaration declaration = result->declarations[declaration_index];
 10124:             u32 declaration_start = declaration.declarator_count ? declaration.declarator_start : declaration.token_start;
 10125:             u32 declaration_end = declaration.declarator_count ? declaration.declarator_start + declaration.declarator_count
 10126:                                                                : declaration.token_start + declaration.token_count;
 10127:             u32 initializer = declaration_end;
 10128:             u32 depth = 0;
 10129:             for (u32 cursor = declaration_start; cursor < declaration_end && initializer == declaration_end; cursor += 1)
 10130:             {
 10131:                 CToken current = preprocess.tokens[cursor];
 10132:                 if (c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) ||
 10133:                     c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
 10134:                 {
 10135:                     depth += 1;
 10136:                 }
 10137:                 else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET) ||
 10138:                          c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE))
 10139:                 {
 10140:                     depth -= depth != 0;
 10141:                 }
 10142:                 else if (!depth && c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_ASSIGN))
 10143:                 {
 10144:                     initializer = cursor + 1;
 10145:                 }
 10146:             }
 10147:             if (initializer < declaration_end)
 10148:             {
 10149:                 if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[declaration_end - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_SEMICOLON))
 10150:                 {
 10151:                     declaration_end -= 1;
 10152:                 }
 10153:                 CType* element = record->element_type.value < result->type_count ? &result->types[record->element_type.value] : 0;
 10154:                 bool element_is_aggregate = element && (element->kind == C_TYPE_STRUCT || element->kind == C_TYPE_UNION ||
 10155:                                                         element->kind == C_TYPE_ARRAY || element->kind == C_TYPE_VECTOR);
 10156:                 if (element && c_ir_tokens_are_string_literals(preprocess, initializer, declaration_end))
 10157:                 {
 10158:                     CIrDecodedString decoded = {0};
 10159:                     if (c_ir_count_string_literal_range_for_target(arena, preprocess, preprocess.target, initializer, declaration_end, &decoded) &&
 10160:                         decoded.element_count != UINT64_MAX &&
 10161:                         c_parse_initializer_string_element_compatible(preprocess, result, record->element_type, decoded))
 10162:                     {
 10163:                         counted_items = decoded.element_count + 1;
 10164:                     }
 10165:                 }
 10166:                 else if (element)
 10167:                 {
 10168:                     counted_items = c_parse_count_plain_initializer_items(preprocess, initializer, declaration_end, element_is_aggregate);
 10169:                 }
 10170:                 counted_element = record->element_type;
 10171:             }
 10172:         }
 10173:     }
 10174:     bool resolved;
 10175:     if (is_enumerator && index == end && !dereference_count && type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 10176:     {
 10177:         // An enumerator has type int, which is 4 bytes with 4-byte alignment
 10178:         // on every supported target; the parse holds no ready-made int type
 10179:         // record to hand c_parse_type_layout here.
 10180:         *size_out = 4;
 10181:         *alignment_out = 4;
 10182:         resolved = true;
 10183:     }
 10184:     else if (counted_items)
 10185:     {
 10186:         u64 element_size = 0;
 10187:         u32 element_alignment = 0;
 10188:         resolved = c_parse_type_layout(0, arena, preprocess, result, counted_element, &element_size, &element_alignment) && element_size &&
 10189:                    element_size <= UINT64_MAX / counted_items;
 10190:         *size_out = element_size * counted_items;
 10191:         *alignment_out = element_alignment;
 10192:     }
 10193:     else
 10194:     {
 10195:         resolved = valid && type.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 10196:                    c_parse_type_layout(0, arena, preprocess, result, type, size_out, alignment_out);
 10197:     }
 10198:     return resolved;
 10199: }
 10200: 
 10201: // Resolves the type name of a sizeof/_Alignof operand without the type-parse
 10202: // machine, for the constant expressions the machine itself evaluates while it
 10203: // runs. The machine is an explicit frame stack with one shared result slot, so
 10204: // a step cannot reenter it; this walks the type table directly instead.
 10205: // An operand that is not a type name at all falls through to
 10206: // c_parse_sizeof_operand_expression_layout above.
 10207: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_machineless_sizeof_operand_layout(Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope,
 10208:                                                                    u32 start, u32 end, u64* size_out, u32* alignment_out)
 10209: {
 10210:     if (start >= end)
 10211:     {
 10212:         return false;
 10213:     }
 10214:     // `(T){...}` is a compound literal, and its size is T's. The base-type
 10215:     // walk below stops at the `(` and the expression walk after it wants an
 10216:     // object name, so without this arm neither answers the shape and the
 10217:     // caller reports the whole constant expression as unfoldable.
 10218:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 10219:     {
 10220:         u32 type_close = c_parse_matching_delimiter(preprocess, start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 10221:         if (type_close + 1 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[type_close + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE) &&
 10222:             c_parse_matching_delimiter(preprocess, type_close + 1, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE) == end - 1)
 10223:         {
 10224:             return c_parse_machineless_sizeof_operand_layout(arena, result, preprocess, scope, start + 1, type_close, size_out, alignment_out);
 10225:         }
 10226:     }
 10227:     // Resolving the operand can append pointer, array, and tag records; keep
 10228:     // them in a copy so an operand never mutates the caller's type table.
 10229:     CParseResult operand_parse = *result;
 10230:     u32 index = start;
 10231:     CTypeId type = c_parse_machineless_base_type(&operand_parse, preprocess, scope, start, end, &index);
 10232:     if (type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 10233:     {
 10234:         return c_parse_sizeof_operand_expression_layout(arena, &operand_parse, preprocess, scope, start, end, size_out, alignment_out);
 10235:     }
 10236:     type = c_parse_machineless_declarator_suffixes(&operand_parse, preprocess, type, &index, end);
 10237:     if (type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || index != end)
 10238:     {
 10239:         return false;
 10240:     }
 10241:     return c_parse_type_layout(0, arena, preprocess, &operand_parse, type, size_out, alignment_out);
 10242: }
 10243: 
 10244: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_scalar_type_core_begin(CTypeParseMachine* machine, CTypeParseFrame* frame, u32* declarator_start)
 10245: {
 10246:     CParseResult* result = frame->result;
 10247:     CPreprocessResult preprocess = frame->preprocess;
 10248:     u32 start = frame->start;
 10249:     u32 end = frame->end;
 10250:     CTypeId qualified_typedef = c_parse_qualified_typedef_type(result, preprocess, frame->scope, start, end, declarator_start);
 10251:     if (qualified_typedef.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 10252:     {
 10253:         return qualified_typedef;
 10254:     }
 10255:     u32 aggregate_index = start;
 10256:     while (aggregate_index < end && preprocess.tokens[aggregate_index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 10257:     {
 10258:         u32 attribute_end = c_parse_skip_alignment_specifiers(preprocess, aggregate_index, end);
 10259:         attribute_end = c_parse_skip_attributes(preprocess, attribute_end, end);
 10260:         if (attribute_end != aggregate_index)
 10261:         {
 10262:             aggregate_index = attribute_end;
 10263:             if (aggregate_index >= end)
 10264:             {
 10265:                 break;
 10266:             }
 10267:             continue;
 10268:         }
 10269:         if (c_token_in_well_known_set(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[aggregate_index], C_PARSE_AGGREGATE_KEYWORDS))
 10270:         {
 10271:             break;
 10272:         }
 10273:         if (!c_parse_type_word_for_dialect_token(preprocess, preprocess.tokens[aggregate_index]))
 10274:         {
 10275:             break;
 10276:         }
 10277:         aggregate_index += 1;
 10278:     }
 10279:     if (aggregate_index >= end || preprocess.tokens[aggregate_index].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER ||
 10280:         !c_token_in_well_known_set(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[aggregate_index], C_PARSE_AGGREGATE_KEYWORDS))
 10281:     {
 10282:         if (aggregate_index == start && aggregate_index < end && preprocess.tokens[aggregate_index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 10283:         {
 10284:             String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[aggregate_index]);
 10285:             // The old entity walk chose the oldest matching typedef, even when
 10286:             // a scoped lookup had already rejected the name. Keep that
 10287:             // fallback contract; the bucket helper validates partial parse
 10288:             // metadata before using the newest-first chain.
 10289:             CEntityId typedef_entity = c_parse_lookup_typedef_name_fallback(result, spelling);
 10290:             if (typedef_entity.value < result->entity_count)
 10291:             {
 10292:                 CEntity* entity = &result->entities[typedef_entity.value];
 10293:                 if (entity->kind == C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF)
 10294:                 {
 10295:                     u32 qualifier_index = aggregate_index + 1;
 10296:                     CTypeId type = entity->type;
 10297:                     if (type.value >= result->type_count)
 10298:                     {
 10299:                         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10300:                     }
 10301:                     CType qualified = result->types[type.value];
 10302:                     bool has_qualifier = false;
 10303:                     while (qualifier_index < end && preprocess.tokens[qualifier_index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 10304:                     {
 10305:                         if (!c_parse_type_qualifier_word_token(preprocess, preprocess.tokens[qualifier_index], &qualified))
 10306:                         {
 10307:                             break;
 10308:                         }
 10309:                         has_qualifier = true;
 10310:                         qualifier_index += 1;
 10311:                     }
 10312:                     *declarator_start = qualifier_index;
 10313:                     return has_qualifier ? c_parse_add_qualified_type(result, type, qualified) : type;
 10314:                 }
 10315:             }
 10316:         }
 10317:         return c_parse_primitive_type(result, preprocess, start, end, declarator_start);
 10318:     }
 10319:     // The words the scan above stepped over to reach the tag keyword. A
 10320:     // qualifier, a storage class or an alignment specifier stands beside a
 10321:     // tag; a word that names a type of its own is a second type specifier,
 10322:     // and reading the tag through it gave `int struct S v` the aggregate's
 10323:     // layout under a spelling it never had. Walking the run again costs only
 10324:     // the declarations that reach a tag, where the scan above already walked
 10325:     // every declaration there is.
 10326:     u32 specifier_index = start;
 10327:     u32 invalid_specifier = UINT32_MAX;
 10328:     while (specifier_index < aggregate_index && invalid_specifier == UINT32_MAX)
 10329:     {
 10330:         u32 decorated = c_parse_skip_alignment_specifiers(preprocess, specifier_index, aggregate_index);
 10331:         decorated = c_parse_skip_attributes(preprocess, decorated, aggregate_index);
 10332:         if (decorated != specifier_index)
 10333:         {
 10334:             specifier_index = decorated;
 10335:         }
 10336:         else
 10337:         {
 10338:             invalid_specifier = c_parse_type_specifier_token(preprocess, specifier_index) ? specifier_index : UINT32_MAX;
 10339:             specifier_index += 1;
 10340:         }
 10341:     }
 10342:     if (invalid_specifier != UINT32_MAX)
 10343:     {
 10344:         c_parse_diagnostic(result, c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, preprocess.tokens[invalid_specifier]),
 10345:             C_DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID_TYPE_SPECIFIERS, S8("invalid or unsupported type specifier combination"));
 10346:         *declarator_start = aggregate_index;
 10347:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10348:     }
 10349:     String8 aggregate_spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[aggregate_index]);
 10350:     CTypeKind kind = string_equal(aggregate_spelling, S8("struct"))  ? C_TYPE_STRUCT
 10351:                      : string_equal(aggregate_spelling, S8("union")) ? C_TYPE_UNION
 10352:                                                                      : C_TYPE_ENUM;
 10353:     u32 index = c_parse_skip_attributes(preprocess, aggregate_index + 1, end);
 10354:     u32 tag_index = index;
 10355:     String8 tag = {0};
 10356:     if (index < end && preprocess.tokens[index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 10357:     {
 10358:         tag = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index]);
 10359:         index += 1;
 10360:     }
 10361:     index = c_parse_skip_attributes(preprocess, index, end);
 10362:     CTypeId enum_underlying_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10363:     if (kind == C_TYPE_ENUM && index < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_COLON))
 10364:     {
 10365:         u32 underlying_start = index + 1;
 10366:         u32 underlying_end = underlying_start;
 10367:         while (underlying_end < end && !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[underlying_end], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
 10368:         {
 10369:             underlying_end += 1;
 10370:         }
 10371:         u32 underlying_declarator = underlying_start;
 10372:         enum_underlying_type = c_parse_qualified_typedef_type(result, preprocess, frame->scope, underlying_start, underlying_end, &underlying_declarator);
 10373:         if (enum_underlying_type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 10374:         {
 10375:             enum_underlying_type = c_parse_primitive_type(result, preprocess, underlying_start, underlying_end, &underlying_declarator);
 10376:         }
 10377:         CType* underlying = enum_underlying_type.value < result->type_count ? &result->types[enum_underlying_type.value] : 0;
 10378:         bool integer_underlying = false;
 10379:         if (underlying)
 10380:         {
 10381:             switch (underlying->kind)
 10382:             {
 10383:             case C_TYPE_BOOL:
 10384:             case C_TYPE_CHAR:
 10385:             case C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR:
 10386:             case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR:
 10387:             case C_TYPE_SHORT:
 10388:             case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT:
 10389:             case C_TYPE_INT:
 10390:             case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT:
 10391:             case C_TYPE_LONG:
 10392:             case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG:
 10393:             case C_TYPE_LONG_LONG:
 10394:             case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG:
 10395:             case C_TYPE_INT128:
 10396:             case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128:
 10397:             {
 10398:                 integer_underlying = true;
 10399:                 break;
 10400:             }
 10401:             case C_TYPE_INVALID:
 10402:             case C_TYPE_VOID:
 10403:             case C_TYPE_FLOAT16:
 10404:             case C_TYPE_BFLOAT16:
 10405:             case C_TYPE_FLOAT:
 10406:             case C_TYPE_DOUBLE:
 10407:             case C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE:
 10408:             case C_TYPE_FLOAT16_COMPLEX:
 10409:             case C_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPLEX:
 10410:             case C_TYPE_DOUBLE_COMPLEX:
 10411:             case C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX:
 10412:             case C_TYPE_VA_LIST:
 10413:             case C_TYPE_NULLPTR:
 10414:             case C_TYPE_POINTER:
 10415:             case C_TYPE_ARRAY:
 10416:             case C_TYPE_VECTOR:
 10417:             case C_TYPE_FUNCTION:
 10418:             case C_TYPE_STRUCT:
 10419:             case C_TYPE_UNION:
 10420:             case C_TYPE_ENUM:
 10421:             case C_TYPE_COUNT:
 10422:             {
 10423:                 break;
 10424:             }
 10425:             }
 10426:         }
 10427:         if (!integer_underlying || underlying_declarator != underlying_end)
 10428:         {
 10429:             return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10430:         }
 10431:         index = underlying_end;
 10432:     }
 10433:     CTypeId type = c_parse_aggregate_lookup(result, kind, tag, frame->scope);
 10434:     bool definition = index < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE);
 10435:     if (!definition)
 10436:     {
 10437:         if (!tag.length)
 10438:         {
 10439:             return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10440:         }
 10441:         if (type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 10442:         {
 10443:             type = c_parse_add_type(result, (CType){
 10444:                                                 .tag = tag,
 10445:                                                 .tag_scope = frame->scope,
 10446:                                                 .element_type = enum_underlying_type,
 10447:                                                 .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
 10448:                                                 .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
 10449:                                                 .kind = kind,
 10450:                                             });
 10451:         }
 10452:         type = c_parse_apply_trailing_qualifiers(result, preprocess, type, &index, end);
 10453:         *declarator_start = index;
 10454:         return type;
 10455:     }
 10456:     u32 open = index;
 10457:     u32 depth = 1;
 10458:     index += 1;
 10459:     while (index < end && depth)
 10460:     {
 10461:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
 10462:         {
 10463:             depth += 1;
 10464:         }
 10465:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE))
 10466:         {
 10467:             depth -= 1;
 10468:         }
 10469:         index += 1;
 10470:     }
 10471:     if (depth)
 10472:     {
 10473:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10474:     }
 10475:     u32 close = index - 1;
 10476:     u32 definition_type_start = result->type_count;
 10477:     // A body against a tag that is already complete is two different things
 10478:     // by scope.  In the same scope it is a redefinition and stays refused.
 10479:     // In an inner scope it is a new, distinct type that shadows the outer one
 10480:     // -- clang's xmmintrin.h defines `struct __mm_storeh_pi_struct` inside
 10481:     // two intrinsics, and the second body must not be read against the
 10482:     // first's completed record, which both mis-sized the second struct and
 10483:     // sent the whole statement back through the expression parser.  An
 10484:     // incomplete found tag keeps its existing completion path whatever the
 10485:     // scope, which is the `struct S; struct S { ... };` forward idiom.
 10486:     if (type.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && result->types[type.value].is_complete)
 10487:     {
 10488:         if (result->types[type.value].tag_scope.value == frame->scope.value)
 10489:         {
 10490:             c_parse_diagnostic(result, c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, preprocess.tokens[tag_index]), C_DIAGNOSTIC_REDEFINITION,
 10491:                                string_format(result->arena, S8("redefinition of tag '{S8}'"), tag));
 10492:             return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10493:         }
 10494:         type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10495:     }
 10496:     if (type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 10497:     {
 10498:         type = c_parse_add_type(result, (CType){
 10499:                                             .tag = tag,
 10500:                                             .tag_scope = frame->scope,
 10501:                                             .element_type = enum_underlying_type,
 10502:                                             .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
 10503:                                             .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
 10504:                                             .member_start = result->member_count,
 10505:                                             .kind = kind,
 10506:                                         });
 10507:     }
 10508:     if (type.value < definition_type_start && !c_type_parse_record_mutation(machine, result, type))
 10509:     {
 10510:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10511:     }
 10512:     CType* aggregate = &result->types[type.value];
 10513:     if (kind == C_TYPE_ENUM && enum_underlying_type.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 10514:     {
 10515:         if (aggregate->element_type.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && aggregate->element_type.value != enum_underlying_type.value)
 10516:         {
 10517:             return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10518:         }
 10519:         aggregate->element_type = enum_underlying_type;
 10520:     }
 10521:     aggregate->member_start = result->member_count;
 10522:     aggregate->definition_start = open + 1;
 10523:     aggregate->definition_token_count = close - (open + 1);
 10524:     if (kind == C_TYPE_ENUM)
 10525:     {
 10526:         aggregate->enum_member_start = result->enum_member_count;
 10527:         u32 enum_start = open + 1;
 10528:         s64 previous_value = -1;
 10529:         // Only a top-level comma separates enumerators. An initializer may
 10530:         // group commas of its own inside parentheses, brackets or braces --
 10531:         // `enum { E = (int)sizeof (struct S){1, 2}, F }` -- and splitting on
 10532:         // one of those cuts the initializer in half and fails the whole
 10533:         // definition.
 10534:         u32 enum_group_depth = 0;
 10535:         for (u32 token_index = enum_start; token_index <= close; token_index += 1)
 10536:         {
 10537:             if (token_index < close && c_punctuator_in_set(preprocess.tokens[token_index].punctuator, C_PUNCTUATOR_SET_DELIMITER_OPEN))
 10538:             {
 10539:                 enum_group_depth += 1;
 10540:             }
 10541:             else if (token_index < close && c_punctuator_in_set(preprocess.tokens[token_index].punctuator, C_PUNCTUATOR_SET_DELIMITER_CLOSE))
 10542:             {
 10543:                 enum_group_depth -= enum_group_depth != 0;
 10544:             }
 10545:             bool enum_end = token_index == close ||
 10546:                             (!enum_group_depth && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[token_index], C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA));
 10547:             if (!enum_end)
 10548:             {
 10549:                 continue;
 10550:             }
 10551:             if (enum_start == token_index)
 10552:             {
 10553:                 enum_start = token_index + 1;
 10554:                 continue;
 10555:             }
 10556:             CToken name = preprocess.tokens[enum_start];
 10557:             if (name.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 10558:             {
 10559:                 return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10560:             }
 10561:             // An enumerator carries its attributes between the name and the
 10562:             // '=', or after the name when it has no value at all:
 10563:             // `enum { A [[deprecated]] = 1, B [[deprecated]] }`. The commas
 10564:             // inside an attribute list are already covered, because the
 10565:             // enumerator split above counts '[' as an opening delimiter.
 10566:             u32 enum_value_index = c_parse_skip_attributes(preprocess, enum_start + 1, token_index);

 10568:             if (enum_value_index < token_index)
 10569:             {
 10570:                 if (!c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[enum_value_index], C_PUNCTUATOR_ASSIGN))
 10571:                 {
 10572:                     return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 10573:                 }

 10579:                                                      &constant_tokens, &constant_token_count))

 10582:                     return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;

 10586:                 u32 expression_count = constant_token_count;

 10588:                 u32 evaluation_token_count = 0;
 10589:                 u64 enum_spelling_capacity = 0;
 10590:                 for (u32 expression_index = 0; expression_index < expression_count; expression_index += 1)
 10591:                 {
 10592:                     enum_spelling_capacity +=

 10594:                 }

 10596:                 bool expression_valid = true;
 10597:                 for (u32 expression_index = 0; expression_index < expression_count; expression_index += 1)
 10598:                 {
 10599:                     u32 source_index = expression_start + expression_index;
 10600:                     CToken expression_token = constant_preprocess.tokens[source_index];
 10601:                     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&expression_token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 10602:                     {
 10603:                         u32 cast_end = expression_index + 1;

 10605:                         bool cast_valid = true;

 10608:                                !c_token_is_punctuator(&constant_preprocess.tokens[expression_start + cast_end], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
 10609:                         {

 10665:                             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&operand_token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))

 10686:                             literal_close = initializer_close < expression_end ? initializer_close : UINT32_MAX;
 10687:                         }

 10689:                         u32 operand_alignment = 0;
 10690:                         if (!parenthesized || operand_depth || operand_end == operand_start ||

 10692:                                                                        operand_end, &operand_size, &operand_alignment))
 10693:                         {
 10694:                             // Substituting zero here would silently misfold the
 10695:                             // enumerator. Diagnose the declaration and retain a
 10696:                             // recovery member so later uses do not cascade.
 10697:                             c_parse_diagnostic(

 10771:                                           c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, name)));
 10772:                     }
 10773:                     else if (evaluated <= INT64_MAX)
 10774:                     {
 10775:                         value = (s64)evaluated;
 10776:                     }
 10777:                     else
 10778:                     {
 10779:                         value = -1 - (s64)(UINT64_MAX - evaluated);
 10780:                     }
 10781:                 }
 10782:                 scratch_end(temporary);
 10783:             }

 10787:                 .location = c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, name),
 10788:                 .symbol = name.symbol,
 10789:                 .value = value < 0 ? (u64)(-value) : (u64)value,
 10790:                 .is_negative = value < 0,
 10791:             };
 10792:             previous_value = value;
 10793:             enum_start = token_index + 1;
 10794:         }
 10795:     }
 10796:     if (kind != C_TYPE_ENUM)
 10797:     {
 10798:         // The definition's own attributes sit on either side of the body:
 10799:         // `struct __attribute__((packed)) P { ... }` writes them between the
 10800:         // keyword and the brace, `struct P { ... } __attribute__((packed));`
 10801:         // after the closing one. Both ranges are scanned back to back so the
 10802:         // alignment records they append stay one contiguous run.
 10803:         bool is_packed = false;
 10804:         u32 attribute_alignment_start = 0;
 10805:         u32 attribute_alignment_count = 0;

 10807:         c_parse_layout_attributes(result, preprocess, aggregate_index + 1, open, &is_packed, &attribute_alignment_start, &attribute_alignment_count);

 10809:             bool suffix_packed = false;
 10810:             u32 suffix_alignment_start = 0;
 10811:             u32 suffix_alignment_count = 0;
 10812:             c_parse_layout_attributes(result, preprocess, close + 1, suffix_end, &suffix_packed, &suffix_alignment_start, &suffix_alignment_count);
 10813:             is_packed |= suffix_packed;
 10814:             if (!attribute_alignment_count)
 10815:             {
 10816:                 attribute_alignment_start = suffix_alignment_start;
 10817:             }
 10818:             attribute_alignment_count += suffix_alignment_count;
 10819:         }
 10820:         if (is_packed || attribute_alignment_count)
 10821:         {
 10822:             // One entry per aggregate, rewritten rather than appended when
 10823:             // the definition is parsed again: the type machine rolls a
 10824:             // speculative parse back and retries it, and a table that grew on
 10825:             // every attempt could outrun the one-per-definition bound its
 10826:             // capacity is sized to and start dropping the answer.
 10827:             u32 record_index = 0;
 10828:             while (record_index < result->aggregate_attribute_count && result->aggregate_attributes[record_index].type_index != type.value)
 10829:             {
 10830:                 record_index += 1;
 10831:             }
 10832:             if (record_index < result->aggregate_attribute_count || result->aggregate_attribute_count < result->aggregate_attribute_capacity)
 10833:             {
 10834:                 result->aggregate_attribute_count += record_index == result->aggregate_attribute_count;
 10835:                 result->aggregate_attributes[record_index] = (CAggregateAttributes){
 10836:                     .type_index = type.value,
 10837:                     .alignment_start = attribute_alignment_start,
 10838:                     .alignment_count = attribute_alignment_count,
 10839:                     .is_packed = is_packed,
 10840:                 };
 10841:             }
 10842:         }
 10843:         frame->type = type;
 10844:         frame->original_type_id = type;
 10845:         frame->original_type_valid = true;
 10846:         frame->definition_type_start = definition_type_start;
 10847:         frame->pending_index = definition_type_start;
 10848:         frame->close = close;
 10849:         frame->has_function_suffix = true;
 10850:         *declarator_start = close + 1;
 10851:         return type;
 10852:     }
 10853:     aggregate = &result->types[type.value];
 10854:     aggregate->member_count = result->member_count - aggregate->member_start;
 10855:     aggregate->enum_member_count = result->enum_member_count - aggregate->enum_member_start;
 10856:     aggregate->is_complete = true;
 10857:     c_parse_validate_flexible_array_members(result, aggregate);
 10858:     u32 enum_declarator_start = close + 1;
 10859:     type = c_parse_apply_trailing_qualifiers(result, preprocess, type, &enum_declarator_start, end);
 10860:     *declarator_start = enum_declarator_start;
 10861:     return type;
 10862: }

 10864: BUSTER_C_SHARED CTypeId c_parse_pointer_chain(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CTypeId base, u32* index, u32 end)
 10865: {
 10866:     while (*index < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[*index], C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR))
 10867:     {
 10868:         *index += 1;
 10869:         CType pointer = {
 10870:             .element_type = base,
 10871:             .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
 10872:             .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
 10873:             .kind = C_TYPE_POINTER,
 10874:         };
 10875:         while (*index < end && preprocess.tokens[*index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 10876:         {
 10877:             String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[*index]);
 10878:             if (c_parse_type_qualifier_word(spelling, &pointer))
 10879:             {
 10880:             }
 10881:             else if (string_equal(spelling, S8("_Nonnull")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("_Nullable")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("_Null_unspecified")))
 10882:             {
 10883:                 /* Nullability affects diagnostics, not the C object
 10884:                    representation. */
 10885:             }
 10886:             else
 10887:             {
 10888:                 break;
 10889:             }
 10890:             *index += 1;
 10891:         }
 10892:         base = c_parse_add_type(result, pointer);
 10893:     }
 10894:     return base;
 10895: }

 10897: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_parenthesized_declarator_name(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 declarator_start, u32 end, u32* name_index)
 10898: {
 10899:     if (declarator_start >= end || !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[declarator_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 10900:     {
 10901:         return false;
 10902:     }
 10903:     u32 index = declarator_start + 1;
 10904:     while (index < end)
 10905:     {
 10906:         while (index < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR))
 10907:         {
 10908:             index += 1;
 10909:             CType ignored = {0};
 10910:             while (index < end && preprocess.tokens[index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 10911:             {
 10912:                 String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index]);
 10913:                 if (c_parse_type_qualifier_word(spelling, &ignored) || string_equal(spelling, S8("_Nonnull")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("_Nullable")) ||
 10914:                     string_equal(spelling, S8("_Null_unspecified")))
 10915:                 {
 10916:                     index += 1;
 10917:                     continue;
 10918:                 }
 10919:                 break;
 10920:             }
 10921:         }
 10922:         // A declarator group may hold another one: the name of

 12030:                     continue;

 12035:                         .left = left_parameter,

 12037:                     };
 12038:                     continue;
 12039:                 }
 12040:                 if (left_parameter_kind == C_TYPE_POINTER && right_parameter_kind == C_TYPE_FUNCTION)
 12041:                 {
 12042:                     stack[stack_count++] = (CTypePair){
 12043:                         .left = result->types[left_parameter.value].element_type,
 12044:                         .right = right_parameter,
 12045:                     };

 12047:                 }

 12049:                     .left = left_parameter,
 12050:                     .right = right_parameter,
 12051:                     .ignore_qualifiers = true,
 12052:                 };
 12053:             }
 12054:             break;
 12055:         }
 12056:         case C_TYPE_STRUCT:
 12057:         case C_TYPE_UNION:

 12061:             // CTypeId, but their unqualified type points at the same
 12062:             // declaration.  Compare that identity rather than the wrapper

 12064:             // and its definition (Unity's display-style enum exercises this
 12065:             // exact redeclaration path).
 12066:             CTypeId left_unqualified = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, pair.left);
 12067:             CTypeId right_unqualified = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, pair.right);
 12068:             compatible = left_type.tag.length ? string_equal(left_type.tag, right_type.tag) : left_unqualified.value == right_unqualified.value;
 12069:             if (compatible && left_type.kind == C_TYPE_ENUM &&

 12071:             {

 12073:                 {
 12074:                     compatible = false;
 12075:                 }
 12076:                 else
 12077:                 {
 12078:                     stack[stack_count++] = (CTypePair){
 12079:                         .left = left_type.element_type,
 12080:                         .right = right_type.element_type,
 12081:                     };
 12082:                 }
 12083:             }
 12084:             break;
 12085:         }
 12086:         case C_TYPE_INVALID:
 12087:         case C_TYPE_VOID:
 12088:         case C_TYPE_BOOL:
 12089:         case C_TYPE_CHAR:
 12090:         case C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR:
 12091:         case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR:
 12092:         case C_TYPE_SHORT:
 12093:         case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT:
 12094:         case C_TYPE_INT:
 12095:         case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT:
 12096:         case C_TYPE_LONG:

 12123: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CSourceLocation c_parse_cleanup_attribute_location(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CCleanupAttributeInfo attribute)
 12124: {
 12125:     CSourceLocation result;
 12126:     if (attribute.first_start < preprocess.token_count)
 12127:     {
 12128:         result = c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, preprocess.tokens[attribute.first_start]);
 12129:     }
 12130:     else
 12131:     {
 12132:         result = (CSourceLocation){0};
 12133:     }
 12134:

 12143: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_cleanup_pointer_conversion(Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CTypeId source_id,
 12144:                                                             CTypeId target_id)
 12145: {
 12146:     if (source_id.value >= result->type_count || target_id.value >= result->type_count)
 12147:     {
 12148:         return false;
 12149:     }
 12150:     CType source = result->types[source_id.value];
 12151:     CType target = result->types[target_id.value];
 12152:     if ((source.is_const && !target.is_const) || (source.is_volatile && !target.is_volatile) || (source.is_restrict && !target.is_restrict))
 12153:     {
 12154:         return false;
 12155:     }
 12156:     if (target.kind == C_TYPE_VOID)
 12157:     {
 12158:         return true;
 12159:     }
 12160:     CTypeId source_unqualified = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, source_id);
 12161:     CTypeId target_unqualified = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, target_id);
 12162:     return source_unqualified.value < result->type_count && target_unqualified.value < result->type_count &&
 12163:            c_parse_types_compatible(arena, result, preprocess, source_unqualified, target_unqualified);
 12164: }

 12166: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_cleanup_function_matches(Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CTypeId declared_type,
 12167:                                                            CEntity* function)
 12168: {
 12169:     if (!function || function->type.value >= result->type_count)
 12170:     {
 12171:         return false;
 12172:     }
 12173:     CType* function_type = &result->types[function->type.value];
 12174:     if (function_type->kind != C_TYPE_FUNCTION || function_type->parameter_count != 1 || function_type->parameter_start >= result->parameter_count)
 12175:     {
 12176:         return false;
 12177:     }
 12178:     CTypeId parameter_id = result->parameters[function_type->parameter_start].type;
 12179:     if (parameter_id.value >= result->type_count)
 12180:     {
 12181:         return false;
 12182:     }
 12183:     CType* parameter_type = &result->types[parameter_id.value];
 12184:     if (parameter_type->kind == C_TYPE_ARRAY || parameter_type->kind == C_TYPE_FUNCTION)
 12185:     {
 12186:         parameter_id = c_parse_add_type(result, (CType){
 12187:                                                    .element_type = parameter_type->kind == C_TYPE_ARRAY ? parameter_type->element_type : parameter_id,
 12188:                                                    .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
 12189:                                                    .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
 12190:                                                    .kind = C_TYPE_POINTER,
 12191:                                                });
 12192:     }
 12193:     if (parameter_id.value >= result->type_count || result->types[parameter_id.value].kind != C_TYPE_POINTER)
 12194:     {
 12195:         return false;
 12196:     }
 12197:     return c_parse_cleanup_pointer_conversion(arena, result, preprocess, declared_type, result->types[parameter_id.value].element_type);
 12198: }

 12200: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_validate_cleanup_attribute(Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CEntityId entity_id,
 12201:                                                              CCleanupAttributeInfo attribute, bool is_typedef, bool is_register, bool is_extern,
 12202:                                                              bool is_thread_local)
 12203: {

 12216:         return false;
 12217:     }

 12221:         return false;

 12226:         result->types[entity->type.value].kind == C_TYPE_FUNCTION)
 12227:     {
 12228:         c_parse_cleanup_diagnostic(result, preprocess, attribute, S8("GNU cleanup attribute may only be applied to an automatic block-scope object"));
 12229:         return false;
 12230:     }
 12231:     CToken function_token = preprocess.tokens[attribute.function_token];
--- lines 12347-12547 ---
 12347: // `0 ? (t *)0 : (void *)!(c)` names `t` when `c` holds and `void` when it does
 12348: // not -- so the arms arrive as token ranges, not just as type ids.
 12349: //
 12350: // Elements that are compatible compose, carrying the union of both arms'
 12351: // qualifiers.  Elements that are not are the case clang reports as
 12352: // -Wpointer-type-mismatch and still types as `void *`; answering `void *`
 12353: // rather than nothing is what makes `*(0 ? (double *)0 : (char *)0)` resolve
 12354: // to `void`, so a declaration written on it is rejected for an incomplete
 12355: // type -- clang's own diagnostic -- instead of never being seen as a
 12356: // declaration at all.
 12357: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_conditional_pointer_type(Arena* arena, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope, CTypeId left,
 12358:                                                              CTypeId right, u32 left_start, u32 left_end, u32 right_start, u32 right_end)
 12359: {
 12360:     CType left_value = result->types[left.value];
 12361:     CType right_value = result->types[right.value];
 12362:     bool left_pointer = left_value.kind == C_TYPE_POINTER;
 12363:     bool right_pointer = right_value.kind == C_TYPE_POINTER;
 12364:     bool left_null = c_parse_range_is_null_pointer_constant(arena, preprocess, result, scope, left, left_start, left_end);
 12365:     bool right_null = c_parse_range_is_null_pointer_constant(arena, preprocess, result, scope, right, right_start, right_end);
 12366:     CTypeId type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 12367:     if (left_pointer && right_null)
 12368:     {
 12369:         type = left;
 12370:     }
 12371:     else if (right_pointer && left_null)
 12372:     {
 12373:         type = right;
 12374:     }
 12375:     else if (left_pointer && right_pointer)
 12376:     {
 12377:         CTypeId left_element = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, left_value.element_type);
 12378:         CTypeId right_element = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, right_value.element_type);
 12379:         if (left_element.value >= result->type_count || right_element.value >= result->type_count)
 12380:         {
 12381:             type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 12382:         }
 12383:         else
 12384:         {
 12385:             CType left_element_value = result->types[left_element.value];
 12386:             CType right_element_value = result->types[right_element.value];
 12387:             bool void_compatible = (left_element_value.kind == C_TYPE_VOID && right_element_value.kind != C_TYPE_FUNCTION) ||
 12388:                                    (right_element_value.kind == C_TYPE_VOID && left_element_value.kind != C_TYPE_FUNCTION);
 12389:             bool element_compatible = void_compatible || c_parse_types_compatible(arena, result, preprocess, left_element, right_element);
 12390:             CTypeId element = left_element_value.kind == C_TYPE_VOID ? left_element : right_element_value.kind == C_TYPE_VOID ? right_element : left_element;
 12391:             CType element_qualifiers = {
 12392:                 .is_const = result->types[left_value.element_type.value].is_const || result->types[right_value.element_type.value].is_const,
 12393:                 .is_volatile = result->types[left_value.element_type.value].is_volatile || result->types[right_value.element_type.value].is_volatile,
 12394:                 .is_restrict = result->types[left_value.element_type.value].is_restrict || result->types[right_value.element_type.value].is_restrict,
 12395:                 .is_atomic = result->types[left_value.element_type.value].is_atomic || result->types[right_value.element_type.value].is_atomic,
 12396:             };
 12397:             if (!element_compatible)
 12398:             {
 12399:                 element = c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, C_TYPE_VOID);
 12400:                 element_qualifiers = (CType){0};
 12401:             }
 12402:             if (element_qualifiers.is_const || element_qualifiers.is_volatile || element_qualifiers.is_restrict || element_qualifiers.is_atomic)
 12403:             {
 12404:                 element = c_parse_add_qualified_type(result, element, element_qualifiers);
 12405:             }
 12406:             type = c_parse_add_type(result, (CType){
 12407:                                                 .element_type = element,
 12408:                                                 .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
 12409:                                                 .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
 12410:                                                 .kind = C_TYPE_POINTER,
 12411:                                             });
 12412:         }
 12413:     }
 12414:     return type;
 12415: }
 12416: 
 12417: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_conditional_expression_type(Arena* arena, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope,
 12418:                                                                 CTypeId left, CTypeId right, u32 left_start, u32 left_end, u32 right_start, u32 right_end)
 12419: {
 12420:     left = c_parse_auto_decay_type(result, left);
 12421:     right = c_parse_auto_decay_type(result, right);
 12422:     if (left.value >= result->type_count || right.value >= result->type_count)
 12423:     {
 12424:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 12425:     }
 12426:     CType left_value = result->types[left.value];
 12427:     CType right_value = result->types[right.value];
 12428:     if (left_value.kind == C_TYPE_NULLPTR && right_value.kind == C_TYPE_POINTER)
 12429:     {
 12430:         return right;
 12431:     }
 12432:     if (right_value.kind == C_TYPE_NULLPTR && left_value.kind == C_TYPE_POINTER)
 12433:     {
 12434:         return left;
 12435:     }
 12436:     // The pointer rules need the arms' spellings and the arithmetic ones do
 12437:     // not, so the constant walk they rest on runs only when an arm is a
 12438:     // pointer -- `condition ? 1 : 2` never pays for it.
 12439:     if (left_value.kind == C_TYPE_POINTER || right_value.kind == C_TYPE_POINTER)
 12440:     {
 12441:         return c_parse_conditional_pointer_type(arena, preprocess, result, scope, left, right, left_start, left_end, right_start, right_end);
 12442:     }
 12443:     if (left_value.kind == right_value.kind &&
 12444:         (left_value.kind == C_TYPE_STRUCT || left_value.kind == C_TYPE_UNION || left_value.kind == C_TYPE_ENUM))
 12445:     {
 12446:         CTypeId left_unqualified = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, left);
 12447:         CTypeId right_unqualified = c_parse_unqualified_type(result, right);
 12448:         if (c_parse_types_compatible(arena, result, preprocess, left_unqualified, right_unqualified))
 12449:         {
 12450:             CType qualifiers = {
 12451:                 .is_const = left_value.is_const || right_value.is_const,
 12452:                 .is_volatile = left_value.is_volatile || right_value.is_volatile,
 12453:                 .is_restrict = left_value.is_restrict || right_value.is_restrict,
 12454:                 .is_atomic = left_value.is_atomic || right_value.is_atomic,
 12455:             };
 12456:             return (qualifiers.is_const || qualifiers.is_volatile || qualifiers.is_restrict || qualifiers.is_atomic)
 12457:                        ? c_parse_add_qualified_type(result, left_unqualified, qualifiers)
 12458:                        : left_unqualified;
 12459:         }
 12460:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 12461:     }
 12462:     if (left.value == right.value)
 12463:     {
 12464:         return left;
 12465:     }
 12466:     return c_parse_expression_arithmetic_type(result, preprocess.target, left, right);
 12467: }

 12469: // Names resolve to intern ids through the borrowed preprocess table; a parse

 12478: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u64 c_parse_entity_lookup_hash(u32 symbol, String8 name, CScopeId scope)
 12479: {
 12480:     u64 hash = symbol ? (u64)symbol * UINT64_C(0x9E3779B97F4A7C15) : c_macro_name_hash(name);
 12481:     hash ^= (u64)scope.value + UINT64_C(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) + (hash << 6) + (hash >> 2);
 12482:     return hash;
 12483: }
 12484: 
 12485: // Bucket key for the name/typedef chains: the interned id when the parse has
 12486: // a symbol table, the byte-FNV of the spelling when it does not (hand-built
 12487: // tests). Every name reaching a probe site comes from a token the
 12488: // preprocessor already interned, so the probe-side c_parse_name_symbol is an
 12489: // identity-path hit, never an insert.
 12490: BUSTER_C_SHARED u64 c_parse_name_hash(u32 symbol, String8 name)
 12491: {
 12492:     return symbol ? (u64)symbol * UINT64_C(0x9E3779B97F4A7C15) : c_macro_name_hash(name);
 12493: }
 12494: 
 12495: // Records `entity` as the innermost binding of `symbol`.  A bind into the
 12496: // file scope while the array already stands for it is never undone, so it
 12497: // costs no record; every other bind pushes the binding it shadows.
 12498: //
 12499: // A bind into a scope the array does not stand for is a bind into an
 12500: // enclosing one: C files a block-scope `extern int f(void);` in the file
 12501: // scope while the walk is inside the block.  That entity is not the
 12502: // innermost binding now, but it becomes one when the shadowing scopes
 12503: // close, so it goes into the oldest record for the symbol -- the value the
 12504: // outermost restore puts back -- or into the slot itself when nothing has
 12505: // shadowed it.  The scan is over the bindings the function body has open,
 12506: // which the reset at each definition keeps to that body's own. Fresh names
 12507: // need no scan. The returned loop cursor exposes examined records to tests;
 12508: // production callers discard it, without maintaining an additional counter.
 12509: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_parse_binding_bind(CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope, CEntityId entity, u32 symbol)
 12510: {
 12511:     u32 scan_count = 0;
 12512:     if (result->binding_by_symbol && symbol && symbol < result->binding_capacity)
 12513:     {
 12514:         if (scope.value != result->binding_scope.value)
 12515:         {
 12516:             u32 oldest = UINT32_MAX;
 12517:             // A live undo record for this symbol always has a valid current
 12518:             // binding: bind installs one, and unwind removes its record before
 12519:             // restoring the previous value. A fresh name therefore cannot
 12520:             // occur in this log, however many unrelated locals it contains.
 12521:             if (result->binding_by_symbol[symbol].value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 12522:             {
 12523:                 for (; scan_count < result->binding_undo_count && oldest == UINT32_MAX; scan_count += 1)
 12524:                 {
 12525:                     oldest = result->binding_undo[scan_count].symbol == symbol ? scan_count : UINT32_MAX;
 12526:                 }
 12527:             }
 12528:             if (oldest == UINT32_MAX)
 12529:             {
 12530:                 result->binding_by_symbol[symbol] = entity;
 12531:             }
 12532:             else
 12533:             {
 12534:                 result->binding_undo[oldest].previous = entity;
 12535:             }
 12536:         }
 12537:         else
 12538:         {
 12539:             if (scope.value)
 12540:             {
 12541:                 BUSTER_VALIDATE(result->binding_undo_count < result->binding_undo_capacity);
 12542:                 result->binding_undo[result->binding_undo_count++] = (CParseBindingUndo){
 12543:                     .symbol = symbol,
 12544:                     .previous = result->binding_by_symbol[symbol],
 12545:                 };
 12546:             }
 12547:             result->binding_by_symbol[symbol] = entity;
--- lines 12796-12996 ---
 12796:             while (entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 12797:             {
 12798:                 if (steps >= result->entity_count || entity.value >= result->entity_count)
 12799:                 {
 12800:                     bucket_chain_valid = false;
 12801:                     break;
 12802:                 }
 12803:                 CEntity* candidate = &result->entities[entity.value];
 12804:                 if (candidate->kind != C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF)
 12805:                 {
 12806:                     bucket_chain_valid = false;
 12807:                     break;
 12808:                 }
 12809:                 entity = candidate->next_typedef_in_lookup;
 12810:                 steps += 1;
 12811:             }
 12812:             if (bucket_chain_valid)
 12813:             {
 12814:                 // Keep the canonical newest-first lookup as the source of the
 12815:                 // result after validation; oldest=true preserves the historical
 12816:                 // ascending entity scan's first exact typedef.
 12817:                 return c_parse_lookup_typedef_name(result, name, true);
 12818:             }
 12819:         }
 12820: 
 12821:         // Preserve the original fallback for absent or malformed lookup metadata.
 12822:         // Ascending entity order is the language's oldest-typedef tie breaker.
 12823:         if (result->entities)
 12824:         {
 12825:             for (u32 entity_index = 0; entity_index < result->entity_count; entity_index += 1)
 12826:             {
 12827:                 CEntity* entity = &result->entities[entity_index];
 12828:                 if (entity->kind == C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF && string_equal(entity->name, name))
 12829:                 {
 12830:                     return (CEntityId){.value = entity_index};
 12831:                 }
 12832:             }
 12833:         }
 12834:     }
 12835: 
 12836:     return C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
 12837: }

 12852: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CEntity* c_parse_first_constant_entity_symbol(CParseResult* result, u32 symbol, String8 name)
 12853: {
 12854:     if (!result->name_lookup_buckets || !result->entity_lookup_bucket_count)
 12855:     {
 12856:         return 0;
 12857:     }
 12858:     u32 bucket = (u32)c_parse_name_hash(symbol, name) & (result->entity_lookup_bucket_count - 1);
 12859:     // The chain is newest-first; the last predicate match is the lowest entity
 12860:     // index, matching an ascending scan over the entity table.
 12861:     CEntity* first = 0;
 12862:     for (CEntityId entity = result->name_lookup_buckets[bucket]; entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 12863:          entity = result->entities[entity.value].next_by_name)
 12864:     {
 12865:         CEntity* candidate = &result->entities[entity.value];
 12866:         if ((candidate->kind == C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR || (candidate->is_constexpr && candidate->has_constant_value)) && string_equal(candidate->name, name))
 12867:         {
 12868:             first = candidate;
 12869:         }
 12870:     }
 12871:     return first;
 12872: }

 12874: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_parse_type_start(CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope, String8 spelling, CPreprocessDialect dialect)
 12875: {
 12876:     if (c_parse_type_word_for_dialect(spelling, dialect) || c_parse_auto_type_word(spelling))
 12877:     {
 12878:         return true;
 12879:     }
 12880:     CEntityId entity = c_parse_lookup_entity(result, scope, spelling);
 12881:     return entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && result->entities[entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF;
 12882: }

 12884: // The token form of c_parse_type_start with its work kept for the caller:
 12885: // the word bits decide for a keyword without a lookup, and a name's
 12886: // scope-chain answer is handed back so a caller that goes on to bind that
 12887: // same token does not look it up a second time.  `*type_word_out` reports
 12888: // that the keyword tests answered, in which case `*entity_out` is invalid.
 12889: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_start_token_lookup(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, CToken token,
 12890:                                                         bool* type_word_out, CEntityId* entity_out)
 12891: {
 12892:     bool starts_type;
 12893:     CEntityId entity = C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
 12894:     bool type_word = c_parse_type_word_for_dialect_token(preprocess, token) || c_parse_auto_type_word_token(preprocess, token);
 12895:     if (type_word)
 12896:     {
 12897:         starts_type = true;
 12898:     }
 12899:     else
 12900:     {
 12901:         entity = c_parse_lookup_entity_token(result, preprocess.spelling_base, scope, &token);
 12902:         starts_type = entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && result->entities[entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF;
 12903:     }
 12904:     *type_word_out = type_word;
 12905:     *entity_out = entity;
 12906:     return starts_type;
 12907: }

 12910: // entity lookup through the token's own symbol.
 12911: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_parse_type_start_token(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, CToken token)
 12912: {
 12913:     bool type_word = false;
 12914:     CEntityId entity = C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
 12915:     return c_parse_type_start_token_lookup(result, preprocess, scope, token, &type_word, &entity);
 12916: }

 12921: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_parse_bind_identifier(Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, u32 token_index)

 12928: // Records the use of the identifier at `token_index` as resolving to
 12929: // `entity`, the answer of a lookup of that token in `scope` the caller
 12930: // already made, and diagnoses an unresolved name unless it is predefined.
 12931: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_parse_bind_identifier_entity(Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, u32 token_index,
 12932:                                                       CEntityId entity)
 12933: {
 12934:     CToken token = preprocess.tokens[token_index];
 12935:     bool first_use = token_index < result->identifier_use_by_token_capacity && !result->identifier_use_by_token_plus_one[token_index];
 12936:     BUSTER_VALIDATE(result->identifier_use_count < result->identifier_use_capacity);
 12937:     u32 use_index = result->identifier_use_count++;
 12938:     result->identifier_uses[use_index] = (CIdentifierUse){
 12939:         .token_index = token_index,
 12940:         .entity = entity,
 12941:         .scope = scope,
 12942:     };
 12943:     if (token_index < result->identifier_use_by_token_capacity && !result->identifier_use_by_token_plus_one[token_index])
 12944:     {
 12945:         result->identifier_use_by_token_plus_one[token_index] = use_index + 1;
 12946:     }
 12947:     // The predefined names -- __func__ and its GNU forms, the __builtin_ and
 12948:     // atomic families, GNU's complex-part operators, C23's true/false/nullptr
 12949:     // -- declare no entity, so the only question they answer is whether an
 12950:     // unresolved name is an error.  A name the scope chain resolved, which
 12951:     // is nearly every one, never reaches the ladder.
 12952:     if (entity.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 12953:     {
 12954:         String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token);
 12955:         if (first_use && c_parse_bfloat16_builtin(spelling))
 12956:         {
 12957:             c_parse_position_index_append(arena, &result->bfloat16_builtin_calls, &result->bfloat16_builtin_call_count,
 12958:                                            &result->bfloat16_builtin_call_capacity, token_index);
 12959:         }
 12960:         bool predefined_function_name = string_equal(spelling, S8("__func__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__FUNCTION__")) ||
 12961:                                         string_equal(spelling, S8("__PRETTY_FUNCTION__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__builtin_va_start")) ||
 12962:                                         string_equal(spelling, S8("__va_start")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__builtin_va_arg")) ||
 12963:                                         string_equal(spelling, S8("__builtin_va_copy")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__builtin_va_end"));
 12964:         predefined_function_name |= string_starts_with_sequence(spelling, S8("__builtin_"));
 12965:         predefined_function_name |= string_starts_with_sequence(spelling, S8("__c11_atomic_"));
 12966:         // The GNU spelling of the same family, which takes ordinary pointers.
 12967:         // CPython's configure probes it for HAVE_BUILTIN_ATOMIC and most Linux
 12968:         // userland reaches for it in preference to the C11 one.
 12969:         predefined_function_name |= string_starts_with_sequence(spelling, S8("__atomic_"));
 12970:         // Admit only the implemented legacy full barrier and NAND spellings.
 12971:         predefined_function_name |= string_equal(spelling, S8("__sync_synchronize")) ||
 12972:                                     string_equal(spelling, S8("__sync_fetch_and_nand")) ||
 12973:                                     string_equal(spelling, S8("__sync_nand_and_fetch"));
 12974:         // GNU's complex part operators are spelled as identifiers but name no
 12975:         // entity; the expression walker consumes them as prefix operators.
 12976:         predefined_function_name |= string_equal(spelling, S8("__real__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__real")) ||
 12977:                                     string_equal(spelling, S8("__imag__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__imag"));
 12978:         predefined_function_name |= c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(preprocess.dialect) &&
 12979:                                     (string_equal(spelling, S8("true")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("false")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("nullptr")));
 12980:         if (!predefined_function_name)
 12981:         {
 12982:             c_parse_diagnostic(result, c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, token), C_DIAGNOSTIC_UNDECLARED_IDENTIFIER,
 12983:                                string_format(arena, S8("use of undeclared identifier '{S8}'"), spelling));
 12984:         }
 12985:     }
 12986: }

 12988: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_identifier_is_bound(CParseResult* result, u32 token_index)
 12989: {
 12990:     return c_parse_identifier_use_index(result, token_index) != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 12991: }
 12992: 
 12993: // One past the `__builtin_offsetof(type, designator)` group whose opening
 12994: // parenthesis is at `open`.  The designator names struct members rather than
 12995: // objects in scope, so an identifier binder walking a token range has to step
 12996: // over the whole group instead of resolving what is inside it.
--- lines 13004-13247 ---
 13004:         {
 13005:             depth += 1;
 13006:         }
 13007:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
 13008:         {
 13009:             if (!depth)
 13010:             {
 13011:                 break;
 13012:             }
 13013:             depth -= 1;
 13014:             if (!depth)
 13015:             {
 13016:                 index += 1;
 13017:                 break;
 13018:             }
 13019:         }
 13020:         index += 1;
 13021:     }
 13022:     return index;
 13023: }

 13025: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_parse_bind_array_bound_identifiers(Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, u32 start,
 13026:                                                               u32 end)
 13027: {
 13028:     u32 bracket_depth = 0;
 13029:     for (u32 token_index = start; token_index < end; token_index += 1)
 13030:     {
 13031:         CToken token = preprocess.tokens[token_index];
 13032:         // An array bound may be spelled with offsetof -- SQLite sizes a save
 13033:         // buffer as `sizeof(Parse) - offsetof(Parse, sLastToken)` -- and the
 13034:         // member named there is not an object this scope can resolve.
 13035:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_token_is_well_known(preprocess.spelling_base, token, C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_BUILTIN_OFFSETOF) &&
 13036:             token_index + 1 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[token_index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 13037:         {
 13038:             token_index = c_parse_builtin_offsetof_end(preprocess, token_index + 1, end) - 1;
 13039:             continue;
 13040:         }
 13041:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 13042:         {
 13043:             bracket_depth += 1;
 13044:             continue;
 13045:         }
 13046:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET))
 13047:         {
 13048:             if (bracket_depth)
 13049:             {
 13050:                 bracket_depth -= 1;
 13051:             }
 13052:             continue;
 13053:         }
 13054:         if (!bracket_depth || token.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER || c_parse_declaration_keyword_at(result, preprocess, token_index) ||
 13055:             c_parse_identifier_is_bound(result, token_index))
 13056:         {
 13057:             continue;
 13058:         }
 13059:         bool member = token_index > start && (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[token_index - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) ||
 13060:                                               c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[token_index - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW));
 13061:         bool tag_name = token_index > start && preprocess.tokens[token_index - 1].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
 13062:                         c_token_in_well_known_set(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[token_index - 1], C_PARSE_AGGREGATE_KEYWORDS);
 13063:         if (!member && !tag_name)
 13064:         {
 13065:             c_parse_bind_identifier(arena, result, preprocess, scope, token_index);
 13066:         }
 13067:     }
 13068: }
