 13070: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_type_kind_is_integer(CTypeKind kind)
 13071: {
 13072:     return kind == C_TYPE_BOOL || kind == C_TYPE_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_SHORT ||
 13073:            kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT || kind == C_TYPE_INT || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT || kind == C_TYPE_LONG || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG ||
 13074:            kind == C_TYPE_LONG_LONG || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG || kind == C_TYPE_INT128 || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128 || kind == C_TYPE_ENUM;
 13075: }
 13076: 
 13077: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_type_kind_is_signed_integer(CTypeKind kind)
 13078: {
 13079:     return kind == C_TYPE_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_SHORT || kind == C_TYPE_INT || kind == C_TYPE_LONG || kind == C_TYPE_LONG_LONG ||
 13080:            kind == C_TYPE_INT128 || kind == C_TYPE_ENUM;
 13081: }
 13082: 
 13083: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_integer_expression_is_unsigned(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, u32 start, u32 end)
 13084: {
 13085:     for (u32 index = start; index < end; index += 1)
 13086:     {
 13087:         CToken token = preprocess.tokens[index];
 13088:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
 13089:         {
 13090:             String8 token_spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token);
 13091:             for (u64 byte_index = 0; byte_index < token_spelling.length; byte_index += 1)
 13092:             {
 13093:                 char8 byte = token_spelling.pointer[byte_index];
 13094:                 if (byte == 'u' || byte == 'U')
 13095:                 {
 13096:                     return true;
 13097:                 }
 13098:             }
 13099:             continue;
 13100:         }
 13101:         if (token.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 13102:         {
 13103:             continue;
 13104:         }
 13105:         CEntityId entity_id = c_parse_lookup_entity_token(result, preprocess.spelling_base, scope, &token);
 13106:         if (entity_id.value >= result->entity_count)
 13107:         {
 13108:             continue;
 13109:         }
 13110:         CTypeId type_id = result->entities[entity_id.value].type;
 13111:         if (type_id.value >= result->type_count)
 13112:         {
 13113:             continue;
 13114:         }
 13115:         CTypeKind kind = result->types[type_id.value].kind;
 13116:         if (kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG ||
 13117:             kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128)
 13118:         {
 13119:             return true;
 13120:         }
 13121:     }
 13122:     return false;
 13123: }
 13124: 
 13125: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_record_constexpr_integer(CTypeParseMachine* machine, Arena* arena, CParseResult* result,
 13126:                                                           CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, CEntityId entity_id, u32 initializer_start,
 13127:                                                           u32 initializer_end)
 13128: {
 13129:     if (entity_id.value >= result->entity_count)
 13130:     {
 13131:         return false;
 13132:     }
 13133:     CEntity* entity = &result->entities[entity_id.value];
 13134:     if (entity->is_constexpr && entity->type.value < result->type_count)
 13135:     {
 13136:         CType value_type = result->types[entity->type.value];
 13137:         if (c_type_kind_is_integer(value_type.kind))
 13138:         {
 13139:             Arena* conflicts[] = {
 13140:                 arena,
 13141:             };
 13142:             TemporalArena temporary = scratch_begin(conflicts, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(conflicts));
 13143:             u64 value = 0;
 13144:             bool evaluated =
 13145:                 c_parse_integer_constant_range(machine, temporary.arena, preprocess, result, scope, initializer_start, initializer_end, &value);
 13146:             scratch_end(temporary);
 13147:             if (!evaluated)
 13148:             {
 13149:                 c_parse_diagnostic(result, entity->location, C_DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID_CONSTEXPR,
 13150:                                    S8("integer constexpr initializer must be an integer constant expression"));
 13151:                 return false;
 13152:             }
 13153:             bool expression_unsigned = c_parse_integer_expression_is_unsigned(result, preprocess, scope, initializer_start, initializer_end);
 13154:             bool negative = value > INT64_MAX && !expression_unsigned;
 13155:             u64 magnitude = negative ? 0 - value : value;
 13156:             u64 size = 0;
 13157:             u32 alignment = 0;
 13158:             bool representable = c_parse_builtin_type_layout(preprocess.target, value_type.kind, &size, &alignment);
 13159:             BUSTER_UNUSED(alignment);
 13160:             if (representable && size <= 8)
 13161:             {
 13162:                 u32 bits = (u32)(size * 8);
 13163:                 bool target_signed = c_type_kind_is_signed_integer(value_type.kind);
 13164:                 if (target_signed)
 13165:                 {
 13166:                     u64 positive_max = bits == 64 ? (u64)INT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << (bits - 1)) - 1;
 13167:                     u64 negative_max = positive_max + 1;
 13168:                     representable = negative ? magnitude <= negative_max : magnitude <= positive_max;
 13169:                 }
 13170:                 else
 13171:                 {
 13172:                     u64 maximum = value_type.kind == C_TYPE_BOOL ? 1 : bits == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << bits) - 1;
 13173:                     representable = !negative && magnitude <= maximum;
 13174:                 }
 13175:             }
 13176:             if (!representable)
 13177:             {
 13178:                 c_parse_diagnostic(result, entity->location, C_DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID_CONSTEXPR,
 13179:                                    S8("integer constexpr initializer is not exactly representable in the declared type"));
 13180:                 return false;
 13181:             }
 13182:             entity->has_constant_value = true;
 13183:             entity->constant_is_negative = negative;
 13184:             entity->constant_value = magnitude;
 13185:         }
 13186:     }
 13187: 
 13188:     return true;
 13189: }
 13190: 
 13191: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_parse_validate_constexpr_initializer(CTypeParseMachine* machine, Arena* arena, CParseResult* result,
 13192:                                                                 CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, CEntityId entity_id,
 13193:                                                                 u32 initializer_start, u32 initializer_end)
 13194: {
 13195:     if (entity_id.value >= result->entity_count)
 13196:     {
 13197:         return false;
 13198:     }
 13199:     CEntity* entity = result->entities + entity_id.value;
 13200:     if (entity->is_constexpr && entity->type.value < result->type_count)
 13201:     {
 13202:         CType* type = result->types + entity->type.value;
 13203:         if (c_type_kind_is_integer(type->kind))
 13204:         {
 13205:             return c_parse_record_constexpr_integer(machine, arena, result, preprocess, scope, entity_id, initializer_start, initializer_end);
 13206:         }
 13207:         if (type->kind != C_TYPE_POINTER && type->kind != C_TYPE_NULLPTR)
 13208:         {
 13209:             return true;
 13210:         }
 13211:         while (initializer_start < initializer_end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[initializer_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 13212:         {
 13213:             u32 depth = 0;
 13214:             u32 close = initializer_start;
 13215:             for (; close < initializer_end; close += 1)
 13216:             {
 13217:                 CToken token = preprocess.tokens[close];
 13218:                 if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 13219:                 {
 13220:                     depth += 1;
 13221:                 }
 13222:                 else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
 13223:                 {
 13224:                     if (!depth)
 13225:                     {
 13226:                         break;
 13227:                     }
 13228:                     depth -= 1;
 13229:                     if (!depth)
 13230:                     {
 13231:                         break;
 13232:                     }
 13233:                 }
 13234:             }
 13235:             if (close != initializer_end - 1)
 13236:             {
 13237:                 break;
 13238:             }
 13239:             initializer_start += 1;
 13240:             initializer_end -= 1;
 13241:         }
 13242:         bool nullptr_value = c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(preprocess.dialect) && initializer_end == initializer_start + 1 &&
 13243:                              preprocess.tokens[initializer_start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
 13244:                              string_equal(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[initializer_start]), S8("nullptr"));
 13245:         u64 integer_value = UINT64_MAX;
 13246:         bool integer_null = c_parse_integer_constant_range(machine, arena, preprocess, result, scope, initializer_start, initializer_end, &integer_value) &&
 13247:                             integer_value == 0;

 13877:         {
 13878:             token_index += 1;
 13879:         }
 13880:         c_parse_diagnostic(result, token_index < end ? c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, preprocess.tokens[token_index]) : c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, preprocess.tokens[start]),
 13881:                            C_DIAGNOSTIC_UNSUPPORTED_SEMANTICS,
 13882:                            S8("block-scope thread-local declarations require static or extern"));
 13883:         return false;
 13884:     }
 13885:     u32 enum_member_start = result->enum_member_count;
 13886:     u32 declarator_start = start;
 13887:     CTypeId base = is_auto_type ? C_TYPE_ID_INVALID : c_parse_scalar_type_in_scope(machine, result, preprocess, scope, start, end, &declarator_start);
 13888:     if (is_auto_type)
 13889:     {
 13890:         declarator_start = auto_info.name_index;

 13892:     // A tag definition's suffix attribute list --

 13899:     // parser already read the list's layout facts off the definition, and

 13964:             {
 13965:                 depth += 1;
 13966:             }
 13967:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET) ||

 13969:             {
 13970:                 if (depth)
 13971:                 {
 13972:                     depth -= 1;
 13973:                 }
 13974:             }
 13975:             else if (!depth && c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA))
 13976:             {
 13977:                 break;

 13980:         u32 suffix_end = segment_end;

 13985:             if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))

 13988:             }

 13991:                 if (suffix_depth)

 14002:         // A GNU `aligned` attribute may follow the declarator rather than the
 14003:         // specifiers (`char scratch[64] __attribute__((aligned(8)));`). The
 14004:         // records it appends have to end up in one contiguous run with the

 14006:         // appended before this loop and before any other declarator's, so the
